notes.title: Patch 3.7.5 is here! Part 1
notes.content:
NEW CONTENT IS HERE!

The Voyage Through the Blighted Isles: Part 1 - The Secret of the Coille

    Level cap raised to 77 for all skills
    A Brand New Zone: Bevyn's Coille
    New Story and Quests
    New Bosses, Achievements, Daily Quests, Items, Recipes, Monsters, Music, and more!



New Features

    New Feature: Legendary Crafting 
        Crafters who craft weapons and gear that are level 70 and higher will now be able to participate in legendary crafting.
        As a player crafts normal weapons and armor, they will become more proficient in their skill with that exact recipe.
        A players ability to craft a recipe will be represented by ranks. Rank one is will be rather easy to obtain, but getting all the way to rank 5 will take effort.
        As a player progresses through recipe ranks, they will begin to craft better items that contain boosts to the items basic stats, boosting things like health, armor, elemental damage, elemental protection, and more.
        At rank 5, a crafter will have a chance to create a legendary item, which can randomly be one of 9 versions for weapons, or one or 4 versions for garb (including hat, gloves, boots, belt, and outfit). Some versions will have different stat boosts, and some are better than others, but all legendary items will have all of their feats, spells, and proficiencies boosted by an entire rank.
        Work diligently by yourself, mastering recipes for your class, or work with others and swap items as you become proficient in recipes. Will you have what it takes to create the ultimate gear?
    New Feature: Item Salvaging 
        Players can now salvage refined ingredients from weapons and armor.
        Head to Ardent City and find the Salvaging Rod Vendor to find a Salvaging Rod that is useful for your level range.
        Functioning similar to how Repair Kits work, hold the Salvaging Rod over the item you wish to deconstruct. Your character will perform the salvaging, the base item will be destroyed, and you will gain some refined ingredients.
        The type and quantity of items salvaged will vary depending on item level and quality, with crafted items producing more than items found in the world.
        Each Salvaging Rod contains 100 charges, so carry one along on your adventures to help keep your inventory clean, and get a few extra refined ingredients at the same time.
    Inventory Quality of Life Improvements: 
        We have added inventory sorting. Players can select which bags to be sorted to have all items in the selected bags put in a nice organized manner.
        We have added a "sell gems" button to all vendors. This will sell all of the gems in your bags to the vendor in one click.
        The sounds while moving items around in the inventory have been improved.
    New Feature: Elite Crafting Quests 
        Many players enjoy that crafting is a difficult task that requires a character to put the work in to become a master at their skills. While we enjoy this aspect as well, we wanted to make crafting a little more accessible early game so players have a better chance to test the waters before their combat level is too far above crafting.
        We have made crafting much easier from levels 1-40. All skills require a much smaller amount of Xp to level up until about level 42-43.
        At level 40 in a crafting skill, an Elite crafting quest will open up. This quest will be challenging, but reward the player with a boost that permanently increases XP gains in a specific crafting skill by 50%.
        The elite crafting quests will be a marker in the players life, noting when the 'easy waters' of crafting stop, and the challenging end game crafting begins.
    Node depletion has been removed (mostly) 
        We have made one final tweak to gathering based on the feedback we have been hearing from the players. We have removed node depletion (with one exception). Instead tools will now wear down faster, and when your tool is broken you can no longer gather (this will prevent botters).
        However, now, while gathering, special repair consumables will 'pop' out of the gathering node. These little globs will not get picked up by auto gather, but must be manually picked up. Players should see them anywhere from every 2-3 minutes (so it is by no means a lot of extra clicking). Picking a globule up will repair your tool, so you can keep on gathering. As long as you are picking up most of the repair globs, you will be able to gather for several hours (without having to rezone to repair tools and replenish nodes)
        The only exception is legacy item shop gathering tools (golden tools) since these items can never break down, they will still use the node depletion with the same balanced numbers as before.
    Death Recap 
        The death window will now explain about the last few attacks that damaged you, follwed by what the killing blow was. This will include the monsters name, what type of attack, how much damage, if it was a critical strike, and what element of damage it was. The hope is that this will help give players bit more information so they can better prepare themselves and understand base game mechanics.



Improvements

    XP Balancing
        We have made some XP table balancing in preparation for new content
        Combat XP: levels 35-55 have been lowered. Levels 55-65 then smoothly readjust back to regular amount. Levels 1-34 and 66-75 are unchanged.
        Village XP (Ranching and Gardening): Values from 45-65 were lowered slightly.
        Crafting XP: Values from levels 10 to 40 have been lowered substantially in preparation for level 40 elite crafting quests.
        Gathering XP: Values from 10 to 40 mirror the crafting changes.
    Charter Adjustments: 
        Non-combat charters have had their combat XP reduced to match reduced XP tables.
       Guard charters had their combat XP lowered slightly to match reduced XP tables.
        Parts charters level 75 and above will now require less parts, but also require the player to travel to a zone, killing 1-2 monsters that match the part they are collecting.
        Parts charters have had their combat XP boosted slightly
    Pyrron Changes 
        Golden Chests of Pyrron, obtain from the dragons of the Deep earth, no longer contain class rings.
        The Arcane Rift is no longer required to complete the Pyrrus story line. The Rift still exists and the bosses are still within, however they no longer drop special monster parts and they no longer require heroes to have specific elder gear.

notes.title: What's new in Villagers & Heroes - Equinox, new item packs, and more!
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Villagers%20%26%20Heroes/vh_2015.png

The past weeks have seen a huge amount of updates to Villagers & Heroes! Brave the scorching desert of the Sands Of The Equinox event zone, find hundreds of new items in our updated item shop, get even better items through daily logins, and enjoy a ton of general improvements, bugfixes and polish!

http://giant.gfycat.com/SeriousHarmlessJohndory.gif

A special event zone unlike any other has just descended upon the Seven Realms! In these waning days of summer, experience the scorching sands and blazing rays of The Oases of Anuk’Amon, a magical desert land where ancient pyramids, floating gardens in the sky, mountainous dunes of sand, and deadly pharaohs with nightmarish powers await.

Players can also look forward to an array of stunning desert-themed outfits to choose from, as well as a number of exciting new pets and toys created only for this one-of-a-kind event zone. 


New item packs!

Not only have we done a major renovation on the item shop, and included a new preview feature for outfits, not to mention having added a huge assortment of new items, but we’ve also created some amazing new starter packs chock full of some very special things!

These hearty packs contain the ideal necessities for combat loving heroes, and craft loving villagers alike, as well as packs specifically designed for both.

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue7/Poster%20Small%20-%20Legendary%20Heroes.jpg

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue7/Poster%20Small%20-%20Homeowner.jpg

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue7/Poster%20Small%20-%20Artificer.jpg

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue7/Poster%20Small%20-%20Vanguard.jpg


And much more!

Be sure to log into Villagers & Heroes to see all the improvements for yourself! We hope you will enjoy all the new content, and wish you a great time in the seven realms.

notes.title: The Ardent Weekly Ledger - Issue 8
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/header.jpg

This week we find out about our latest great sale, read an extensive interview with Madam Ladybug, and much more!

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_for_sale.png
A fantastic sale for one week only!

Wednesday, September 23rd was the official day of Equinox, and to celebrate it in grand fashion, we launched a massive sale in our item shop – all Equinox outfits and toys are 50% off! This incredible deal lasts for one week only, and will end on Wednesday, September 30th.

In the Equinox section of the item shop, you’ll find a total of 10 outfits to choose from, as well as the one-of-a-kind Sankata Companion, and the Equinox Alignment Trinket. Don’t miss out on this fantastic sale!

http://www.villagersandheroes.com/weekly/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/outfit1.gif
http://www.villagersandheroes.com/weekly/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/outfit2.gif
http://www.villagersandheroes.com/weekly/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/outfit3.gif
http://www.villagersandheroes.com/weekly/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/outfit4.gif


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_did_you_know.png

When we released Patch 3.5.6 last week, in addition to the Equinox zone, the build had a great many new changes in it – some of the changes went over quite well, and some did not. We carefully poured over all of the forum posts and feedback posted by our players, and spent a lengthy meeting discussing all of the points made.

One of the many benefits of live game development is the active role played by the people whom the game is for – the players. Our goal always is for the creation process to be a partnership between the devs and the community. To that end, we took your feedback of the last week and spent a good deal of time analyzing it, and brainstorming possible solutions, which we have since implemented with some new changes in this current patch.

Did you know that we specifically made a number of adjustments with regards to repairing weapons and gear? Here are the changes we made, and hope this will remedy—or at least be seen as a compromise—on what was a somewhat heated issue:


We dropped the price of repairing gear, weapons, and tools.
We boosted the amount that a repair kit repairs gear by 50%, and boosted the amount that repair kits repair weapons by 4.5x.
We reduced the gold cost of creating crafted repair kits for kits level 65 and above.
Ardent Society members will now receive some Repair Effluxes each month.
We increased the time it takes to wear down a weapons durability by 50% (so weapons last longer before needing repaired).


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_interview.png
Madam Ladybug

View the full issue to read the interview with Madam Ladybug!

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_fan_works.png

One of the many benefits of having such an international community as ours, is that we are constantly given the opportunity to learn about other popular events, pastimes, and activities in different countries all around the globe.

This week, for example, thanks to a V&H player on EU 2, the Otters learned all about a certain radio program and You Tube series that is widely popular in Germany called, Fünf für, or ‘Five for.’ (http://www.radiowmw.de/musik/fuenf-fuer.html)

In this program, people are interviewed without being asked questions. The interviewees (musicians, actors, etc.) are handed five objects, and then must say the first few things that pop into their heads when looking at them, immediate associations, thoughts, that sort of thing.

Bluerider of EU 2 has created her own version of ‘Five For’ and submitted it to the Ledger for any willing Otters to answer. Ivar and Sarah couldn’t refuse! So here is Bluerider’s version of ‘Five For’ – she chose all of the images herself, and gave us no explanations as to why she had chosen them….

Five for Ivar and Sarah

http://www.villagersandheroes.com/weekly/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/blazers.jpg
Object #1 – Portland Trail Blazers coffee mug

Ivar: Oh, morning coffee… how I love you. There isn’t much work that isn’t fueled by the real black gold, for me nor many other otters! Then there’s lunch coffee… and afternoon coffee… and evening coffee…

Sarah: Either this ‘Five For’ thing is rigged, or the EU 2 interviewer is creepily psychic because that’s the city I grew up in, and the Blazers were my team! Clyde Drexler. Jerome Kersey. Memorial Coliseum long before it was the Moda Center. Obliterating the Lakers that one year…Jack Nicholson mad about it. 

http://www.villagersandheroes.com/weekly/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/happycamper.jpg
Object #2 – “Happy Camper” T-Shirt

Ivar: I got a few camping memories! It was never a family occasion when I grew up, as in many American households, but despite my protests I was still dragged out into the cold by over-enthusiastic school staff. I love nature – but there’s something about organized camping that can be far more stressful than relaxing. Luckily I always brought programming literature to keep me busy – huge tomes of a thousand pages each! A pain to carry in a backpack, but there’s nothing like reading up on C++ variable data types next to a cozy campfire.

Sarah: Welcome to the camp/ I guess you all know, why we’re here/ My name is Tommy/ And I became aware this year/ If you want to follow me/ You’ve got to play pin ball/ And put in your earplugs/ Put on your eye shades/ You know where to put the cork — The Who. And now that song is going to be in my head all day.

http://www.villagersandheroes.com/weekly/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/montblanc.jpg
Object #3 – Montblanc ball pen

Ivar: This brings me back to when I was younger, and used to make many ballpoint pen illustrations – hardly masterpieces, but it was fun nonetheless! Always trickier when you can’t erase your mistakes, though of course, it often makes for more interesting art…

Sarah: An unaffordable item for an indie game dev. 

http://www.villagersandheroes.com/weekly/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/ladle.jpg
Object #4 – Ladle

Ivar: Ah, lentil soup, always my trusty companion! My wife and I do a lot of cooking, and this absolute staple food of ours never gets old. The world would be a happier place with more lentils in it.

Sarah: “No soup for you!” (Seinfeld) And also, cooking is not my strong suit. At all. Pretty sure I’ve never owned a ladle, or if I did, I definitely never used it.

http://www.villagersandheroes.com/weekly/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/pat.jpg
Object #5 – Picture of Patrick Stewart

Ivar: Why, Captain Jean-Luc Picard of the USS Enterprise-D, of course! The best commanding officer Star Trek have ever seen, bar none. (and also the only commanding officer that seems to only get younger as time passes!)

Sarah: I was watching a 70’s movie a few years ago, and about fell out of my chair when I discovered that once upon a time, this man did indeed have a full head of hair.

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_behind_the_scenes.png

The Equinox build is exotic, and allows us to roam an expansive desert (albeit virtually) under a gorgeous blue sky, where we can trek up and down a sea of endless dunes, clad in our billowing robes. So this build got the Otters and Neonga thinking about some of their own favorite desert-themed films and books, which conjure up similar images of scorching adventure and the sights, sounds and feelings of a desert.

So just for fun, here is a list of all the team members’ personal picks for their favorite film featuring a desert in it, and their favorite book or short story featuring a desert in it.

Ivar (Artist)
Film: Star Wars
Short Story: The Veldt by Ray Bradbury

Thorsten (Community Manager)
Film: Lawrence of Arabia
Book: Gertrude Bell: Queen of the Desert, Shaper of Nations by Georgina Howell

Ryan (Artist)
Film: The Mummy
Book: Heir to the Empire by Timothy Zahn

Chris (Art Director)
Film: Aladdin
Book: none

Damon (President)

notes.title: Patch 3.5.6 - The Equinox Build - Has Arrived!
notes.content:
http://giant.gfycat.com/SeriousHarmlessJohndory.gif

A special event zone unlike any other has just descended upon the Seven Realms!  In these waning days of summer, experience the scorching sands and blazing rays of The Oases of Anuk’Amon, a magical desert land where ancient pyramids, floating gardens in the sky, mountainous dunes of sand, and deadly pharaohs with nightmarish powers await.

The Equinox event zone is for players of any level, where old friends and new friends alike can come together and partake in epic battles against increasingly challenging bosses.  But this place of frightening beauty isn’t just for the combat driven.  With its numerous quests and opportunities to earn an abundance of exotic treats and rewards, the Oases of Anuk’Amon offers something for everyone.

Players can also look forward to an array of stunning desert-themed outfits to choose from, as well as a number of exciting new pets and toys created only for this one-of-a-kind event zone.


What Else Is New in Patch 3.5.5?
In addition to the Equinox zone, the Mad Otter team has been hard at work making a number of improvements to Villagers & Heroes, as well as implementing some exciting new features!  Here’s a look at what we’ve been up to:

A renovated item shop, which includes:  a new preview outfit feature, a greatly expanded selection of appearance packs to choose from, new toys, new pets, a new line of crafting tools, new potions and boosts, and the introduction of ‘Enchanted Gear.’
Four Brand New Steam DLC packs – (insert links)
New Lucky Card prizes
A revamped Daily Login Reward System
New improvements made to the Hunter class
New UI improvements
Added chat commands so players can walk, jog, and run
Added new crown packages
Added a new option slider – “Pixelation”
Countless bug fixes


To read the full patch notes, please visit https://forum.villagersandheroes.com/showthread.php?11546-English-Patchnotes-3-5-6-Wednesday-September-16

notes.title: The Ardent Weekly Ledger - Issue 6
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/header.jpg

This week we learn of the upcoming Equinox event, read about the man behind V&H's music, and read player and developer interviews!

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_latest_news.png
Coming soon: Equinox!

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue6/equinox.png

That’s right, it’s just a matter of days now until the Equinox event zone, in all its scorching, blazing glory, descends upon the Seven Realms. The Oases of Anuk’Amon, with its vast dunes of sand, royal blue skies, deadly Pharaohs, and so many other exotic delights, is soon to arrive.

You can expect new outfits, new toys, new pets, and increased danger! Tick-tock… 

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_did_you_know.png

Have you ever wondered about the music in Villagers & Heroes? Where do so many of those gentle acoustic melodies, or entrancing symphonic pieces come from that so uniquely match the personalities of the zones in our game?

His name is Kevin MacLeod, and for several years now V&H has been fortunate enough to be able to incorporate countless pieces of this incredibly talented musician’s work into the game. (Close to 100 tracks, in fact, within Villagers & Heroes, are all Kevin’s!)

How did Mad Otter come to be so lucky? Like so many others, we owe it all to this musician, who, because of his utter distaste for the current copyright system, decided to distribute all of his original music free of charge to any and all who might desire to use it on his website: Incompetech.com.

He asks only for credit, nothing else. The result? Artists, filmmakers, game devs, web entrepreneurs, You Tube video makers, and the list goes on and on, are all able to create their own projects and see their visions fulfilled with genuinely beautiful music, and without having to go through a series of often insurmountable hurdles to do so.

Kevin is a hero in the world of independent arts, so much so, that a feature documentary film is currently being made about him, the funding for which came from Kickstarter — many of the donors themselves, having been those who had utilized Kevin’s music for their own projects in the past. (Royalty Free: The Music of Kevin Macleod)

And it’s not just struggling indie artists who appreciate Kevin’s work. Acclaimed film director Martin Scorsese (Taxi Driver, Raging Bull, Goodfellas, The Departed) was so impressed with Kevin’s music that he featured it in his 2011 film, Hugo.

Villagers & Heroes owes an enormous debt to this talented musician. Thank you, Kevin MacLeod!

You can also listen to Kevin’s music (for free) at: https://soundcloud.com/kevin-9-1


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_interview.png
V&H Player: Rhea

View the full issue to read the entire interview with our Rhea, one of our dedicated players!

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_behind_the_scenes.png
Creating Outfits

Outfits! How exactly do they come into being? How do our artists take an image in their heads and transform it into the colorful attire your toons are wearing today? Fortunately, our very own Mad Otter artist, Ryan, is here today to describe the process she goes through when designing and implementing character outfits in the game.

Ryan:

The first thing I do is think about what is being asked of me. For the Reborn starter outfits, for example, the main guideline was that they needed to look good, but couldn’t look like high level gear. I also wanted the gear to make sense – the fabric and design used should be simplistic and/or have a reasonable backstory. Then I start by brainstorming. I pull out fantasy books, look for inspiration on-line, ask the Otters for their thoughts, etc. Once a few ideas begin to form, I begin drafting (sketching) them down by hand in a sketchbook.

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue6/design_behindscenes.JPG

As soon as I have nailed down a design that I am happy with, the next step is to grab the texture files, open them up in Photoshop, and start digitally painting. Most of the time, I get the basic shape drawn in, and then I bring it into my Max file where I can view it on the 3D model. It’s a back and forth process. Working on the textures. Saving out the file. Viewing it on the model, and then making adjustments based on what I see until I’m satisfied. This can take a long time, and I tend to explore other possibilities. Sometimes an error or doodle that I do for fun, leads to the finalized version I keep.

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue6/warrior1_behindscenes.png

Once I’m happy with the texture, I bring it in-game to see how it looks. Rarely does it look great on the first try, though sometimes it does. Often, I find that the game drains a lot of the color and detail I put into my work. It is pretty disappointing at times when I can’t figure out a way to make those details pop out realistically.

I also have to keep in mind both the female and male versions of the outfit at the same time. I want the outfits to match as closely as I can possibly get, so if I am working on a male outfit and went through a process that I know will be hard to recreate later, I’ll switch over to the female and redo what I had done while it is fresh in my mind.

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue6/warrior_behindscenes.png

The Warrior starter outfits were the easiest, and the most fun to do. (Assassin was pretty fun, too! As well as the Ice Wizard.) But for the warrior, I only had to make some slight adjustments to the original design, and once that was done everything flowed together very smoothly, and I was ready to tackle the other classes! It did set a standard for the rest of the outfits, so some designs had to be revised to look stronger.

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue6/firewiz_behindscenes.png

Fire Wizard, on the other hand, was probably the hardest outfit for me. I had drafted down a soot covered robe, but I thought of taking it a step further and made the outfit smolder with embers. It drove me nuts. I desperately wanted fire, to make it seem like this outfit was burning due to a mistake the low level Wizard caused. However, it wasn’t reading well and the outfit looked much abused. It wasn’t a nice starting outfit…so Chris pulled me from my madness and I made the nice simple red robe you see now.

View the full issue to keep reading this segment on how outfits are created in the game!

notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/header.jpg

First of all - our apologies for not making an announcement available last week - naturally, issue 4 of the ledger is fully accessible here.

Onto Issue 5, this week we get to check out tons of user-generated content, such as player-made interviews, monster designs, and knowledge books!

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_latest_news.png
Knowledge books by Lill

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue4/knowledgebook_lillita2.gif

Our game is truly fortunate to have dedicated players who put their time and energy into creating fantastic informative guides and web sites, the contents of which benefit the entire community.

Lillita of EU 1, with the help of Xoka and Mark01, have created four separate knowledge books on the subjects of Plant Lore, Fishing, Mining, and Bug Lore.

Each book, complete with pictures and the ability to turn pages, provides a detailed guide as to where every respective item is located, their levels, their recipes, any quests related to the items, tips, tricks, and, in general, all relevant information pertaining to that gathering lore.

 The books, with their smooth, clean design, are extremely user-friendly, not to mention quite beautiful. Fantastic work, Lillita, Mark01, and Xoka!

To view these excellent knowledge books, please visit this website:
http://vohguides.info/?page_id=3431

They can also be seen at:
http://anyflip.com/homepage/jzew


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_interview.png
Fan-made interviews

View the full issue to read two interviews conducted entirely by our player community!


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_contest.png
Monster Drawing Contest Results

The winners of the Design Your Own Monster contest have been selected! The contest asked for participants to not only draw, or create through any artistic means, their own monster, but also to then provide a brief written synopsis of their creature.

The results were absolutely amazing! You can view all of the entries here:
https://forum.villagersandheroes.com/showthread.php?11391-Design-your-own-monster-Contest-ENTRIES

Mad Otter artists, Ivar and Ryan, the judges, had the unenviable task of having to select the first, second, and third place winners. They deliberated for an entire day, carefully going back and forth between all of the submissions. Eventually, decisions were made, but they did not come easily, given the terrific quality of all the work.

But here they are, the winners of the Design Your Own Monster contest:

First Place: Kookaburra (US 1)
Second Place: Sighfrid (EU 1)
Third Place: Selia (EU 1)

Take a look below at the work of the first place winner, Kookaburra.

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue4/feenix1.jpg

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue4/feenix2.jpg

Feenicks

Lives in one of the Pyron Zones – maybe Sapphira’s Lament. He lives in a hidden glade where the sun never reaches.

Like the phoenix of legend, he returns from his own ashes in a burst of flame. When you think he is dead, you see him crumble in a pile of ashes. Then, with a flash so sudden and bright you are temporarily blinded, he spreads his flaming wings and rises above you.
 He does not shoot fire as other bounties do, rather his fiery wings repel you with intense heat. He pushes you back or throws you aside with a rush of forge-hot-air, perhaps into the arms of his waiting minions. The burst of flames when he is reborn inflicts great damage and disconnects any targeting you may have on him.

He is most vulnerable to distance attacks but any article sent his way (a hunter’s arrow for example) may well be consumed in flame before doing any damage. The surest way to kill a phoenix is with ice. If you are quick enough to douse his ashes with water before he rises, you may kill him finally and completely. It is very unlikely that a single player could kill Feenicks, and even a group of players must approach him with a strategy and act with precision to extinguish his rebirth before he arises again and again.

Feenicks is aloof and proud. He has existed for millennia, ruling over his tiny domain with an exalted sense of his own role in the world. He expects to vanquish you but his hubris can be used against him. A coordinated team of all players can overcome his fierce and supercilious nature.


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_monster_compendium.png
Draknia

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue4/draknia.gif

View the full issue to read the captivating story behind Draknia, the Ember Skink!

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue4/knowledgebook_lillita2.gif

Our game is truly fortunate to have dedicated players who put their time and energy into creating fantastic informative guides and web sites, the contents of which benefit the entire community.

Lillita of EU 1, with the help of Xoka and Mark01, have created four separate knowledge books on the subjects of Plant Lore, Fishing, Mining, and Bug Lore.

Each book, complete with pictures and the ability to turn pages, provides a detailed guide as to where every respective item is located, their levels, their recipes, any quests related to the items, tips, tricks, and, in general, all relevant information pertaining to that gathering lore.

 The books, with their smooth, clean design, are extremely user-friendly, not to mention quite beautiful. Fantastic work, Lillita, Mark01, and Xoka!

To view these excellent knowledge books, please visit this website:
http://vohguides.info/?page_id=3431

They can also be seen at:
http://anyflip.com/homepage/jzew


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_interview.png
Fan-made interviews

View the full issue to read two interviews conducted entirely by our player community!


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_contest.png
Monster Drawing Contest Results

The winners of the Design Your Own Monster contest have been selected! The contest asked for participants to not only draw, or create through any artistic means, their own monster, but also to then provide a brief written synopsis of their creature.

The results were absolutely amazing! You can view all of the entries here:
https://forum.villagersandheroes.com/showthread.php?11391-Design-your-own-monster-Contest-ENTRIES

Mad Otter artists, Ivar and Ryan, the judges, had the unenviable task of having to select the first, second, and third place winners. They deliberated for an entire day, carefully going back and forth between all of the submissions. Eventually, decisions were made, but they did not come easily, given the terrific quality of all the work.

But here they are, the winners of the Design Your Own Monster contest:

First Place: Kookaburra (US 1)
Second Place: Sighfrid (EU 1)
Third Place: Selia (EU 1)

Take a look below at the work of the first place winner, Kookaburra.

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue4/feenix1.jpg

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue4/feenix2.jpg

Feenicks

Lives in one of the Pyron Zones – maybe Sapphira’s Lament. He lives in a hidden glade where the sun never reaches.

Like the phoenix of legend, he returns from his own ashes in a burst of flame. When you think he is dead, you see him crumble in a pile of ashes. Then, with a flash so sudden and bright you are temporarily blinded, he spreads his flaming wings and rises above you.
 He does not shoot fire as other bounties do, rather his fiery wings repel you with intense heat. He pushes you back or throws you aside with a rush of forge-hot-air, perhaps into the arms of his waiting minions. The burst of flames when he is reborn inflicts great damage and disconnects any targeting you may have on him.

He is most vulnerable to distance attacks but any article sent his way (a hunter’s arrow for example) may well be consumed in flame before doing any damage. The surest way to kill a phoenix is with ice. If you are quick enough to douse his ashes with water before he rises, you may kill him finally and completely. It is very unlikely that a single player could kill Feenicks, and even a group of players must approach him with a strategy and act with precision to extinguish his rebirth before he arises again and again.

Feenicks is aloof and proud. He has existed for millennia, ruling over his tiny domain with an exalted sense of his own role in the world. He expects to vanquish you but his hubris can be used against him. A coordinated team of all players can overcome his fierce and supercilious nature.


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_monster_compendium.png
Draknia

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue4/draknia.gif

View the full issue to read the captivating story behind Draknia, the Ember Skink!

notes.title: The Ardent Weekly Ledger - Issue 2
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/header.jpg

This week we take a look at Store redesigns, interview our Community Manager, take a look at livestreaming and player events, and much more!


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_latest_news.png
Coming soon: Item Shop previews!

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue2/shop2.gif

In addition to new content, V&H has a number of other exciting improvements and features in store for you! Like what, you ask? How about: a completely renovated item shop in which players will at long last have the ability to preview all outfits and accessories first. That’s right, the days of wondering if that shade of blue or green is right for your priest, or if the latest event zone garb will suitably match your wizard staff are over!

The preview feature will enable players to dress up their own toon in any outfit displayed in our item shop – and the attire options to choose from will have increased considerably. We’ve added a number of new special appearance packs, as well as class specific packs. Hunters, Warriors, Wizards, and Priests will all have exclusive garb to choose from, not to mention a few other little surprises.
The Ardent Weekly Ledger will continue to reveal more about what players can look forward to in upcoming editions.


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_interview.png
V&H Staff: Tiberius

View the full issue to read the entire interview with our community manager, Tiberius!


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_did_you_know.png
Live Streaming

We are incredibly fortunate to not only have a dedicated player who live streams Villagers & Heroes on a regular basis, thereby increasing exposure for our game, but who also was kind enough to write an informative article for us on the topic, which will be so helpful to players who are interested in learning how to live stream. Thank you, Truthfairy!

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue2/tf_video2.gif

Live Streaming & Twitch – By TruthFairy

View the full issue to read TruthFairy's overview and tutorial on live streaming!


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_behind_the_scenes.png
Furry Tales

View the full issue to read about the V&H dev team and their pets!


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_ardent_stories.png
Big Bug Bonanza!

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue2/Bug-Bonanza-Pic-1.jpg

Recently, ‘Legends Reborn,’ a guild on US 1, threw an amazing, week-long event called, BIG BUG BONANZA. It sounds like a hoot, not to mention the worthiness of its altruistic purpose.
Here to describe the event for you is the player, Avenian: (thanks Avenian!)

One aspect of Legends Reborn (formerly United Arms), is to help our guildies by stocking nodes. To do this, we have some key members who organize this by storing gathers, stocking the guild vault, and checking on nodes. So what do you do if your supplies are getting low?

Our resident Bug Lady (a.k.a. Puzzler), was looking for a way drum up excitement about bugs in a fun way. I had recently been pulled into the bug world, Bug Boy was my title, so the two of us created the BIG BUG BONANZA!!! 

This guild event asked guildies to gather bugs, and in return we gave draw tickets for a chance to win some great prizes. Our guild and guildies stepped up and helped donate many prizes. We were able to offer various xp potions, diamonds, a Golden Magnifying Glass, pies, and sockets to name a few.  All in all, we had 17 prize packs to be won.

The response was overwhelming. We had 33 participants collect almost 160,000 bugs. I had to get four more vaults on my alt in order to store my share and Puzzler had bugs coming out of her village house. This allowed us to provide bugs to guildies to do charters, silks, and to help leveling Bug Lore.  It also spawned our 2nd Bug Event, BIG BUG BONANZA 2: ELECTRIC BUGALOO, as well as my promotion to Senior Bug Boy (I have the badge and everything!!!).

The success of this event and others is due to the amazing support of everyone in Legends Reborn. The participation, donations, and feedback we got back, made this a great success. It is a great way to add even more excitement and pleasure of playing V&H.

Avenian
Legends Reborn
US1


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/c_contest.png
Design Your Own Monster Contest!

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Weekly%20Ledger/issue2/karl_contest.jpg

Get out your pens or paints, or boot up Photoshop, or grab whatever your preferred tool for artistic expression is, and get ready to go to town! Puzzler of US 1 has a Design Your Own Monster contest for you all! The deadline for entries is August 31. The winners will receive crowns, and we’ll also feature the first place monster here in the Ledger.

For more details, please visit our forums at:
https://forum.villagersandheroes.com/showthread.php?11390-Design-your-own-monster-Contest-Information


As always, you can go to www.villagersandheroes.com/weekly to see the full issues with all content!

notes.title: English Patchnotes 3.4.1 - Monday July 20 2015
notes.content:
Complete Patch Notes

Improvements

    Add an option for Full, Minimal, Auto Size for HUD.
    Chat tabs never expand with full text now.
    Changed it so that when a new player buys a house, their rent is paid up for two weeks
   Added more description to Arquin's quest to make it clear that it has a level requirement.




Bugs Fixed

    Fixed: the looting boxes/crates/etc. window does not close, and you can keep getting items from them (that disappear when you relog).
    Hopefully help players with very slow load times not get disconnected while loading a zone.
    Fixed a bug where /block was not giving an accurate list of who was blocked - we think block is (and was) working, but the command to list who was blocked was not working (but now it is).
    Fixed a bug that caused game messages to not be correctly sized.
    Fixed: the drop rate of Parchments in Undercroft is too low (this fix will help other quests as well).
    Fixed: the pop-up that shows you received supplies was removed
    Fixed: Targeting Bugs
        Nearly every time I target a mob/bounty, it targets them then quickly untargets for a second then retargets the bounty and stays targeted, but if i don't wait and use a feat on the mob before that second targeting, then it automatically retargets to the closest bounty. This is a giant pain in the butt. (https://forum.villagersandheroes.com...l=1#post107201)
        In Traven and Zanzidon Grotto I had problems keeping bounties targeted. I would target the bounty and challenge only to find it had retargeted a mob nearby. I was specifically checking the feat distance yet it would disengage the bounty and retarget a mob. It happened more than one time. (https://forum.villagersandheroes.com...l=1#post107203)
    Fixed: bugs with the Arquin quest
    Fixed: Floating mountain in Zanzidon Grotto
    Fixed: Hole in Crystal Spires
    Fixed: Crafting window filter references Vim
    Fixed: Elder Soul effect references Vim




Misc Notes

Note: We received this report on the forums- please submit an in-game bug report after this bug occurs, and we can see the cause: "When I track a quest and then click on it to open the quest journal, the book opens to a blank page." (https://forum.villagersandheroes.com...l=1#post107189)

notes.title: English Patchnotes 3.3.1 - Monday July 13 2015
notes.content:
Complete Patch Notes 


    Bugs Fixed 

        Fix for exclamations getting messed up after zoning.
        Fixed: The ping and pkloss text was in black color and always stayed at -1 for ping and -100.0 for pkloss
       Fixed: Key bindings couldn't be changed when using a modifier (shift, control or alt). The modifier was detected and entered as the key binding.
       Fixed: The icon for the blue water nymph hat looks red actually. Upon wearing it it is blue.. just the icon seems wrong.
        Fixed: Yorick's hat description is wrong, says 15% instead of 25%
        Fixed it so the quest item "Evil Tusker Horns" now stack in inventory.
       Fixed it so non-rebirthed characters who did the event last year can do the quest again.
        Fixed: Monsters were targeting characters even after the player died.
        Fixed: in sawmill theres 3 "nodes" for rotten old growth, even though the one in the middle with a name is the only one that works
        Fixed: Enok in Cronk Island dies but lays there for several seconds before disappearing and dropping his loot. (This happened with several toons.
        Updated: "Sprig of the Vale" item from the event zone is a little glitchy. The tooltip for the effect now states that it only works while on terrain.
        Fixed several issues where selection would stop working until you deselected everything (for example, selecting a vendor would interfere with selecting other players or mobs until you deselected).
        Fixed: Quest tracker X was small and would flicker when you mouse over it.
        Fixed: auction item quantity text was too big and couldn't fit stacks of thousands.
        Fixed: the item shop bag would flash every time you logged in, even if no new items were in it.
        Hopefully fixed a bug where if you die during a ladder bounty fight, and the bounty dies before you revive, you'll teleport to the next boss and be in a weird half-alive half-dead state.




    Improvements 

        Made it so players can be transferred through the bounty ladder multiple times per day, but they can still only get the credit (and tears) once.
        Balanced the vale bounty ladder
            All bosses max health was reduced by about 10%
             All elemental boosts on all bosses was reduced
        The launcher now has a "Clear all Settings" button that will delete all prefs except login email and password, in case settings get corrupted.
        Changed the camera so it instantly snaps back to position instead of moving out slowly. This was to fix some jittery camera problems.
        Added an option to make chat window show up above windows (such as crafting window, character window, etc.) when focused on.
        Added an option to use a basic system font instead of fancy handwritten font, to enhance readability. Note that this option is currently experimental, and some text may look bad with this enabled!
        When the V&H window is shrunk small enough, the HUD now changes to increase view space:
            The HUD portrait disappears and many icons are moved into the menu.
            Inventory box and bottom action bar shrinks.




    Misc Notes 

        [might be fixed in 3.2.2] The mayor ballot window is still broken (black background for each candidate) (https://forum.villagersandheroes.com...l=1#post105394)
        [working as intended] https://forum.villagersandheroes.com...l=1#post105987- Comment: If you resize the chat area above a certain size, it'll consider itself 'expanded' and darken the background and expand the chat tab buttons. It will then store that size as the 'expanded' size, and when you press the expand button in the top right, it'll toggle between normal size and that stored expanded size.
        This is working as intended: "When a party member is in another zone, you can no longer click on their name to bring up the second panel that shows his status, etc. (https://forum.villagersandheroes.com/showthread.php?11135-POST-ONLY-Bugs-for-Patch-3-2-2-No-other-discussion-please&p=105794&viewfull=1#post105794)"- Comment: You can't select players that are a different zone.
        [probably fixed] After zoning to Shadowed Zanzidon, the map bitmap shows Shadowed Zanzidon, but the bounty markers are from a different zone. (https://forum.villagersandheroes.com...l=1#post106163)- Comment: Guessing this is the problem where, after you zone, map markers stop working. Should be fixed in next build.
        We cannot reproduce this report "While trading, items are still often invisible. (https://forum.villagersandheroes.com/showthread.php?11135-POST-ONLY-Bugs-for-Patch-3-2-2-No-other-discussion-please&p=105794&viewfull=1#post105794)". Comment: We tried several times accepting trade with both characters, accepting with one and canceling with other, and just canceling; in the case of accept trade, the items traded as they should, and in the case of cancel, they went back as they should.

notes.title: Midsummer's Eve Arrives!
notes.content:
Midsummer's Eve has arrived, and with it a magical portal to a realm filled with mischievous faeries!

Patch Notes 3.2.2
Improvements

The Vim shard vendors have moved back a little bit off the path to make room for the Midsummer Revelers, but they are still there under the trees!
Yorick's Gathering Hat: We increased the change of getting a mote of yorick while wearing this hat to 40% (instead of 15% without the hat).
Party UI can now be shrunk or hidden altogether.
Chat UI is now always on top of party UI and center bar as long as it's in focus.
COG Suppliers now have icons over their heads when they have supplies available.
Adjustments to hopefully decrease loading time and increase framerate.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed: There were some places you could get stuck in the Valley of Oblivion
 Fixed an issue with giving Balfoure the Sumpty Cabernet. Future players will no longer be able to get bugged, but if a player is already bugged they will need to return to Gormlaith who will give them another bottle. Taking the new bottle back to Balfoure will fix the quest and let it proceed.
 Fixed: Level locked all quests level 45 and above. 
 Fixed: Sequenced locked several of the higher Pyrrus quests to prevent exploits and broken quests. 
 Fixed: Set several Pyrrus quests to be main quests (for filtering in the quest journal)
 Fixed: Spiders near the infested farmshack in Lower Ethos no longer aggro on sight.
 Fixed: To get full XP credit for a zingara kill, a player must be at least 10 levels below the zingaras level. However a player any amount of levels above the zingara will still get full credit. 
 Fixed: Moved Celestria in Mounds so she won't sink into the ground. (This also fixes some missing NPC's elsewhere like Horace and Rhyming Rowena).
 Fixed: "the quest journal for the big spiders are bigger than small gnomes quest says 'he will give me a special damage potion if i help him' but the reward is a clockwork harvester."
 Hopefully fixed bug causing game to freeze for long periods of time and then disconnect while entering a zone between 60% and 80%.
 Fixed bug causing bug report to sometimes fail to send.
 Fixed: Making your character shorter or taller would affect run speed and jump height.
 Fixed: I gathered my daily supplies. The amounts that I received were inconsistent with the amount that is stated in system messages.

Note: When opening an item from the inventory, system text will no longer tell you how many you got.

 Fixed: Bug: "Confusion on the missing pickaxe quest.
 Fixed: local teleporters (e.g. in Traven) sometimes show up as not found even if they have been found.
 Removed the Mortimer Quest - it was too buggy.
 Fixed bug causing village rank selector to almost immediately disappear.
 Fixed: characters who have lost their house sometimes still seem as if they're in the village.


Known Problems
Here are some things we're planning to fix soon:

 The mischevious faeries are a little too...well, mischevious. They will be made a bit easier next week.

notes.title: Patch Notes 3.1.1 (part 2)
notes.content:
Bug Fixes 

        Fixed: Level 11 fruit tree in addicts won't let you pick fruit from it. You click on it and nothing happens. loc -284 35 323 There are other trees near by.

        Hopefully fixed bug causing health, spirit, etc. to get frozen and not update even after taking damage etc.
        Hopefully fixed a bug causing quests and bounties to occasionally stop working after a rebirth, until relog.
        Fixed a bug causing the game to crash while loading if config.cs or prefs.cs was corrupted.
        Fixed a bug causing players to lose their rebirth if they increased any skill (not just their combat level) up to their old level.
        Fixed: Clicking on Rankings, Buy Crowns, Game Guides etc. was not opening a browser on some computers.
        Fixed text that didn't update in the skills window and rapid crafting slider.
        Fixed: swapping items between inventory and village vault caused the item that ended up in inventory to remain with old icon (tooltip is correct however).
        Fixed: attempting to equip items from the wrong class appeared to work, but in actuality they'd be backwards (tooltip would be correct).
        Fixed a bug causing players to get caught at Eamon after turning in the pages. (Players who were caught will need to talk to him again for the quest to progress.)
        Fixed a bug that would cause Tarquin to have no dialog (would often times show up as the last dialog the player read). Players who had this bug will need to talk to Helga and get another Apriquat Biscuit, then talk to Tarquin.
        Fixed a bug that would cause a players quest to get stuck if they lost Tarquin's tablet (Tarquin will give you another now).
        Fixed the windows in the crypts for Village graveyard.
        Add Ayden back to Ardent City
        Shift-Z was fixed. It shows frames per second, ping, and other game diagnostics.
        Fixed The fishing spots in lady's lake are invisible. Also, Vinton.
        Fixed the floating garden ramp at 831 -543 50 in Lower Ethos Island
        Fixed the three woodcrafting tables near Marigold Marina to work.
        Fixed some of Rickardi's text to be correct (and not talk about carpentry).
        Fixed so crafted chess pouches no longer drop small vim pots. They will occasionally drop Motes of Yorick instead.
        Fixed the level 20 elder fragment to say where Elk's Shadow really is.
       Fixed: the /bug chat command wouldn't work.
        Fixed: Yelena's Bug Quest in Lady's Lake does not give the player an update (like most quests do) that the quest is done.
        Fixed: Mutagen Zogs no longer are in game or drop
        Fixed: When I die in Ethos Island, I resurrect at 13 25 121, on a hillside
        Fixed: Yorick's Hat description - Description reads "...does not increase the oods of finding supplies...". should be odds.
        Fixed: Removed the tutorial message in the keep about aggro.
        Fixed: The prickly herb at location "You are at 623 -149 53 in Lower Ethos Island" is impossible to select to gather the calming thistle.
        Fixed: -171 211 19 Briny Caverns: something is launching missiles through the rock wall and hitting me - I can't see them



    Notes 

        Player report: "This morning I entered in game and after a short loading (like a patch), I inserted email and pass to log in, and I have noticed that the new font used has changed, now is much larger and more invasive!"
            Otter Note: This means the custom font isn't getting set up correctly. Please send us an in-game bug report.
        Player report: "The strangest thing is the attitude, set to heroic but in game is cool, but if I put cool in game is shy (lol)! See pics.(https://forum.villagersandheroes.com...l=1#post103258)
            Otter Note: From what we can tell this is just a delay between setting in the character window and in-game.
        Player report: "If i get poisoned while i have a curse, the curse is gone. She says both the icon and effect of the curse is gone when she get poisoned."
            Otter Note: Mummies curses share the same 'slot' with one another. So if you get cursed by one mummy with one type of curse, and then a second mummy curses you with another (like decay, the poison over time curse), it will stomp the old one. I tested all the mobs around the area that it was reported in and nothing stomped the mummies curse except other mummies (code looks solid too).



    The following bug reports we cannot reproduce:

        Federico and Stella don't have quest markers in oak valley. Also, their quest pertains to mega-looters, but those are no longer available in the item shop. maybe it should be adjusted to more current information.
       The daily fishing charter NPC, Tasny, in Elk Meadow is missing an exclamation point over his head. (Not sure, but the brick house behind him might be obscuring it.) Oldn, the bugs daily NPC in Mounds, is also missing a daily quest marker.
            Otter Note: You have to be level 5 for both of these to show. Also, depending on how many quests you have, it may take a while for it to show after zoning into the zone.
        Mortimer is still broken. When the lucky card is used, the quest does not complete.
        I made a hat and it is nowhere to be found - tried relogging, tried moving stuff around, tried moving zones. The hat i crafted inexplicable showed up inside vault - not sure how that one happened as I was at the tailory.
            Otter Note: If it happens again, please send an in-game bug report 



    Known Problems 

    Here are some things we're planning to fix soon:

        Character height is (incorrectly) altering run speed.
        Occasional Lag - spell/feat icons turn green, and cannot be used for several seconds
        Bug Report fails to send for some players.
        Sometimes when Gardening, the character animation will stutter
        UI
            create a more minimal UI for systems with lower resolutions
            don't close windows when clicking outside them
            an option to use a non-italicized font for text
            Solve the problem Priests have with conflicts between party gui and chat gui.
       Zombie bug: "Sometimes after I die, I just stand there with monsters hitting me like I am still alive."

notes.title: Patch Notes 3.1.1 (part 1)
notes.content:
Gathering Changes

        Boosted Mote of Yorick drop chance across the board
            Base chance: boosted from 5% to 15%
            Hasty Herb Chance: boosted from 0.5%-5% (level 1, level 75) to 3%-9%.
            Normal Herb Chance: boosted from 1.5%-15% (level 1, level 75) to 7%-21%
            Yorick's Jewlery: boosted from 4%-20% to 5%-26%
            Gold price dropped from 14s 95c to 12s 95c.
            Changed it so if you have Mote Find greater than 100%, you get a chance at a second Mote of Yorick.
            Cornucopia have been boosted. Instead of 3 charges at 90%, they now contain 5 charges a 100%. All charter variations are rebalanced to take this into account. The chance to find them is now slightly more rare (0.5%)
            Gathering hats now also increases the chance to find Motes of Yorick by 15%. With the new base mote chance of 15%, this doubles a hat wearers chances to find Motes of Yorick.
        We have removed all ranks of supplies (ranks being the level ranges). Instead all supplies of a gathering skill will work at any level node.
            We kept all the rarities of supplies (common, superior, premium).
            We have added two new types of supplies: No trade superior and No trade premium. These items will work just like normal superior and premium supplies, but they will be separate items (including a different name and a different icon).
        This will leave a total of five items per gathering skill:
             Common Supplies (No Trade)
             Superior Supplies (No Trade)
             Premium Supplies (No Trade)
             Superior Supplies (Trade-able)
             Premium Supplies (Trade-able)
        In total this will be 20 item (5 items * 4 skills) compared to 48 items from the old system (4 ranks * 3 rarities * 4 skills). That is 28 items less.
        This is where and how you will acquire these items:
            Common Supplies (No Trade): Can be found while gathering, Will be given out by daily distributors, can be purchased with COG coins.
            Superior Supplies (No Trade): Can be purchased using COG coins.
            Premium Supplies (No Trade): Can be purchased using COG coins.
            Superior Supplies (Tradable): Can be found while gathering.
            Premium Supplies (Tradable): Can be found while gathering, can be purchased using charter tokens.
        All COG values (buy / sell / trade) have been adjusted to fit the new system.
            COG patrons will now accept any type of supply in exchange for COG coins (common, superior, premium, superior (no trade), premium (no trade)).
            A Note on this: All five can go in, but only three can come out. This means any of the five supply types listed above can be traded to a COG patron, but only the three no trade versions can by purchased using COG coins. Consequently, players can never take a trade-able supply, trade it with COG, and get a trade-able supply back out. The COG patron will give you a special warning about this issue.
        Common Supplies will no longer be sold for Gold.
        COG coins can now be purchased with Gold.
        Transition from old types to new types:
            All old supply types will be converted to new types by the system when the build goes live.
            Any unopened bounty salvage, charter bags, or daily bags, will now contain the new type of item.
            If somehow a player still has an old item type after the build goes live, that item will still work for gathering.
        Xinzen carp were balanced to take into account the new changes.
        Normal Herbs that give the Abundant Earth effect, now last for 20 minutes rather than 5. Hasty herb duration remains the same.
        Bounties no longer drop Bounty Salvage. Instead bounties will give COG coins based on the level of the bounty.
        COG coins now stack to 9500 (used to be 5000)
        When a character first gathers with no supplies selected, a tutorial message appears.



    Improvements 

        We made the X that indicates an item cannot be used smaller and less aggressive
        Made Mail text and Auction House quantity text easier to read.
        The "Mail" button was moved into the top-left HUD frame, and now flashes when new mail is received, as it did before Reborn.
        The dark background behind the crafting window, friends window, and all the other windows has been removed, allowing you to chat and move items about while the windows are open.
        Changed "Social" to "Friends"
        When a character first gathers with no supplies selected, show a tutorial popup.

notes.title: Patch 3.03
notes.content:
Improvements

    The pauses that were occurring when players were running around have been (mostly) removed. There may still be some pauses, but it should be much better. This fix also helps the fly over that plays upon entering Ethos the first time, and load times for all zones were generally improved.




Bug Fixes

    Motes of Yorick no longer drop from water gathering.
    Fixed: gathering with supplies took longer than intended because it was not counting the beginning of the animation (throwing the fishing line, crouching to look at bugs, etc.) in the time. In particular, gathering with Common Supplies was intended to take about three seconds from beginning of animation to getting items, but could take five seconds depending on the animation.
    Fixed: trying to use an item after gnogmenting would say "You are busy".
    Fixed a bug causing feats, stats, and combat in general to get broken after a Mummy casts Wither on you.
        Hopefully that also fixes this: Sometimes the health orb glitches and I have more or less health than It displays. Same with the exp bar. (https://forum.villagersandheroes.com...l=1#post102913)
    Garden Items and Water will now stack to 1000
    Fixed a floating lamp at-279 -219 62 in Lower Ethos Island
    Fixed some hidden bug nodes in the village
    Fixed gathering nodes in Oak Valley to drop the correct level item.
    Fixed the quest Understanding the Understudy, certain players were getting stuck getting eggs for Hubert (some players might have seen this when they were trying to help carwen gathering gum)
    Fixed Lady Phillipa to finish your quest if you cancel her dialog in the middle.
    Fixed it so if you lose your salamander soap, Penelope will give you another.
    Fixed Clotilde asking for Honey Damselfish.
    Fixed Yoricks Hat so it wasn't gathering at a 3x rate
    We increased respawns- hopefully spiders, etc., respawn more frequently
    Fixed a bug causing a crash for certain players when they click on the chat box.
    Hopefully fixed a bug causing a crash for certain players with older graphics cards when they tried to enter the character create screen.
    Fixed issues where, after a rebirth, quests and bounties are weird and don't work properly until you relog.
    Fixed a number of issues related to shared vault, such as account-bound items not being able to be dropped in it, items disappearing after being put in shared vault until a relog, etc. We believe this will also fix issues with vim shards disappearing or moving about until a relog.

notes.title: REBORN Patch Notes - Part 4
notes.content:
(continued from part 3)

Bug Fixes

fixed: Quizmato doesn't wear the guide outfit like Quizmay and Quizmo.
fixed: At 760 158 97 in Keppel Cavern there is a hump/barrier in the narrow path that you cannot get past.
fixed: 189 -324 133 in Crystal Spire -- a player can accidentally drop into this spot and become stuck inside rocks.
fixed: When you take the Drom teleporter TO the Antler vendor, it often places you on an extremely precarious ledge.
Npcs no longer wander and get stuck on objects (Npcs like Eumendese, Mary, Rando, Olimpias, etc.).
Fixed a bug with certain monsters effects being more powerful than they should against liberty drams?
Fixed:Kriemhild in Daggertooth Pits refers to 10 gold; it should be 10 copper.
Fixed: At 72 -94 192 in Shadow Fated Traven, the teleporter is floating above the ground.
Fixed: At -83 -47 347 in Cook Cavern, two trees are really floating!
Fixed: Sidhes Are paralyzed, one of the Banshee NPC's are missing. Note: Cassandra is now fixed (though she does move). And those sidhes are babies, they don't attack.
Various Quest typos fixed.
Fixed the funny looking tree in Ardent near the Starry Night statue.
Fixed: When weapons are worn on a toon's back, they partially disappear into the toon.
Fixed: Movement when revived from death (with or without wobbles). When you revive (especially if you don't use a resurrect ball), movement is random. If you tell the toon to go forward, it might go to the left...or to the right...or backwards...sometimes right through a portal.
Fixed: keys (such as A, D, ctrl, alt, etc.) could sometimes get 'stuck', causing a spinning movement of camera and requiring those keys to be pressed again to make the spinning stop.
Fixed: window could be re-sized to any size while loading.
Removed the "Museum of Antiquities" sign
Fixed:You can mine from inside the rock at 518 -132 186 in Kiwa.
Fixed: Mobs killed near 277 6 155 in Isle Rega drop their loot in a rock and you cannot retrieve it. Note: This was a problem with the collision mesh, you could actually physically pass into the rock here.
Fixed some but not all cases of the Camera Jitters
Fixed: Animation for angel wings is glitched on players' toons.
Fixed: closing dialog from an NPC, then rapidly selecting another NPC, could cause your character to get confused and unable to interact until after deselecting the NPC.
    Fixed: in-game bug reporting would always fail.



Other Notes

Turned off the Easter Eggs
Turned off the Sugarsweet Summit Event Zone



Known Problems
These are problems we are aware of, and we are working to fix as quickly as possible.


The narrated fly-over that new characters see the first time they enter Ethos Island is choppy. This is not a problem with your computer, but a problem we are working on.
We know that some players with Item gear like Kangaroo Boots and Golden Winged Helm may have gnogmented some of the special abilities from this gear onto high level gear, and that when they do a Rebirth, they will have a difficult choice of either a) not having access to those abilities after the Rebirth or b) moving the abilities to new low level gear (and losing the high level gear). We are aware of this problem and we are working on a solution quickly.
Character height is affecting the run speed (it should not!)
Some of the User Interface still needs a make-over, most especially the Knowledge Book.
The crafting stations still reference Vim.
It is almost impossible to go up on this ramp. >... The other ramp is fine, but this one has some sort of invisible something that keeps you from walking forward.
On Live, If you press shift + Z you can view FPS and ping, but on Test pressing it won't show anything now.
Viperous Viceroy Quest: the Salamander's Soap quest item can be thrown away, and it is not returned when you talk to the npc again.
The camera jitters when you back your character up into a cliff or a wall.
Auto-Attack Bug: It's not always being activated automatically.
The blinking mail notification is not working
After you do a Rebirth, Quests are not re-activated until you log out and log back in.
It's not possible to Chat when the Crafting Window is open.
Sometimes a player cannot plant a certain square in their garden.
Weapon with drag and drop in bag is very large while it's being dragged
K opens skills now, not talents.
Odd things happen when I try to equip a priest of warrior shield. It acts like it equips the shield, then the shield turns translucent in my inventory and it can't interact with it any more, It doesn't show as equipped on my outfit screen, but i can't move it or delete it out of my inventory any more.

notes.title: REBORN Patch Notes - Part 3
notes.content:
(continued from part 2)


Lake Kiwa

Old System: Vim tutorial.
New System: Gathering Safe Haven. All Vim tutorials have been temporarily removed, and will be replaced with gathering strategy tutorial system in the future. COG representatives are present at Lake Kiwa.

Purchased Hats - Aggrandize

Old System: Increased max vim by 20-30
New System: Increases chance to recycle (not use) supplies.



If Vim is gone, does that mean I can craft endlessly? Yes. As long as you have the mats, you can craft for as long as you want. There is no gate.

Will crafting use supplies? No. Supplies are used only in the gathering skills.

What happens to golden tools in this new system? No change whatsoever. Golden tools yield the exact same results as before.


Art Improvements

Made the female and male player hands smaller
Improved many of the female faces and heads
Improved the World Map
Improved some of the local maps
Made the trees look nicer (for the art techies, added custom normals to make them appear fuller). Also gave them a better texture.

GUI Improvements

"Shop Vault" was renamed to "Shop Items".
Added a total stack value to the tool-tips that tells you the selling price for the entire stack of items
Quick action bars on the inventory window can now have bound hotkeys.

Misc Improvements

Improved Gardening rarities: Improved the rarity system of crops to help differentiate between different types (magical vs common, or hasty vs. normal)
Added a Reflection slider to Settings->Graphics. Note: even on the second notch, reflections have a big impact on frame rate. Only on Extreme are they enabled by default, and even then not at the highest setting. However, if you have a fantastic graphics card, you could try moving reflections to the max.
Improved the Stinging Blasio and Jabs daily quests
The Villagers & Heroes 'Game Guide' on the web site has been updated, and now reflects all changes made within the past year, as well as new info for pre-existing sections.

Graphics Improvements

Boosted the frame rate by over 50%!
Reflections now are ON when a player selects Extreme for graphics setting.
Reflections no longer reflect everything in the scene - just the big stuff. (Reflections in the water now reflect the sky, the mountains, the clouds, but not all the creatures and trees. * This improves the frame rate.)
Changed minimum res to 960x760
The camera avoids fewer objects, leading to fewer jarring camera movements.

Playbalance Improvements

Reduced the amount of lucky gems that drop by but increased their sell value. Players will see a lot less gems popping out of gathering nodes and mob deaths, but because of the increased sale price the gold received by the player will be a perfect wash.
We increased health regeneration when not in combat by 2.3x.
We reduced crafting XP Requirements by a significant amount at the higher levels (so it will be a little easier to keep crafting levels equal to combat level).
Because of this, several of the higher level recipes (levels 40+) will also change as well, lowering the base amount of refined materials needed.

Pyrron Playbalance and Improvements

Medallion Balancing: Addressing issues that we have heard from the community, we took a pass at the Pyrrus Medallion system, attempting to make it a bit easier and less of a grind.
Added: Sapphirra's Lament, Pyrron Courtyard, Lower Keep, and Pyrron Mezzanine, now all drop Obsidian Medallions.
Lowered: Bastion and Ramparts key prices have been lowered from 300 to 200 Obsidian Medallions
Changed: Bastion and Ramparts no longer drop Obsidian Medallions, but instead drop Malachite Medallions.
Lowered: Undercroft and Apothecary prices have been lowered from 700 to 325 Obsidian Medallions
Lowered: Underbelly and Creation Caves have been lowered from 325 to 200 Malachite Medallions
Changed: Underbelly and Creation Caves no longer drop Malachite Medallions, but instead drop Carnelian Medallions
Added: Creation Caves, being a difficult zone to navigate, now has double medallion drops (all bounties drop 2 medallions).
Lowered: Armory and Staging chambers have been lowered from 725 to 325 Malachite Medallions
Lowered: Key to Keppel Cavern has been lowered from 750 to 600 Carnellian Medallions

Pyrrick Acorns
Pyrrick Acorns can now by purchased using any of the Pyrron Medallions types. Visit the Goblin vendors in Sapphiras Lament to see specific pricings.
Drop rates on acorns has been increased slightly

Stone Steps
All Insurgent gear (rings, belts, and gloves that removes the stone step effects) have had their minimum level restriction reduced by two levels each.
All Insurgent gear has had its gold value reduced by half.
Stone Steps no longer nullifies all speed boost modifiers, but instead reduces any bonuses you do have, never reducing the player below default movement speed.
Note: There will be no compensation for players who have already played through these zones with old stone steps effect.

Zone Brightening: We have heard players mention that several of the cavernous Pyrrus zone feel too dark and gloomy. We want to take an attempt at making these zones more fun to be in (this does not affect the dungeon type environments).

Low Level Zones - General Improvements

Improved the Following Zones by adjusting the levels of the monsters and the quests and art improvements: Ardent City, Elk Meadow, Ardent Castle, Southern Coast, Kingsport, Shadow's Den (new zone!), Oak Valley, Villages, Mounds, Vinton, Bearhold Valley, Addict's Ascent, Cook Village, Traders Path, Green Gate, Sirens Course, Bearhold Crypt, Forgotten Reservoir, Southern Marsh, Zombie Town
Old Summer's Hollow and Oak Valley have been visually updated and re-purposed to fit as level 15 and level 20 zones. Players might see a few familiar faces.
Elk Shadow has moved from Elk Meadow. He found a new home...

Portal Changes

The portal to Maiden and back is now accessible from Mounds.
The portal to Blackfury Gorge and back is now accessible from Badlands.


(continued in part 4)
