notes.title: REBORN Patch Notes - Part 2
notes.content:
(continued from part 1)

There are three different categories of supplies, and each yields a greater benefit to the player who has equipped their tools with them. However, it is not a requirement that one must equip their tools in order to gather.



Using No Supplies

Results in a 5 second gathering time
50% chance to find gathering material (e.g. fish, ore, wood, etc.)
100% chance to find 1-2 common gathering supplies for the current skill
0% chance to find supplies for another skill

Using Common Supplies

Results in a 3 second gathering time
100% chance to find gathering material (fish, ore, wood, etc.)
50% chance to find supplies for another skill (nectar, grindstones, etc.)

Using Superior Supplies

Results in a 2 second gathering time
100% chance to find gathering material (fish, ore, wood, etc)
75% chance to find gathering supplies for another skill (grindstones, nectar, etc.)

Using Premium Supplies

Results in a 1 second gathering time
100% chance to find gathering material (fish, ore, wood, etc.)
100% chance to find supplies for another skill (grindstone, worms, etc.)


Superior and Premium Supplies are fully trade-able. Common supplies, unlike the others, are not trade-able. However, every 22 hours, all players will have a stock amount of Common Supplies replenished for free, if they visit certain NPC's. These NPC's, Distributors, belong to a special group known as the Coterie of Gatherers (C.O.G. for short) and they can be found in Ardent City, Summer’s Hollow, and on the shores of Lake Kiwa, with the other members of their Coterie. C.O.G members are easily recognizable in their green robes and blazing gold emblems.

Who are the members of the C.O.G, and what do they do?

Distributors: C.O.G Distributors will serve out daily rations of supplies to all players. There is a C.O.G Distributor for Fishing, Mining, Plant Lore, and Bug Lore. Visit each of them once per day to collect your share.
Patrons: C.O.G Patrons will take Common Supplies from you in trade for C.O.G. coins. C.O.G. coins can be redeemed at a C.O.G. Quartermaster.
Quartermasters: C.O.G Quartermasters will sell you Common Supplies in exchange for varying rates of C.O.G coins.
Vendors: C.O.G. Vendors will sell Common Supplies for varying rates of gold, the official currency of the Seven Realms.


* C.O.G npc's only deal in Common Supplies, not Superior or Premium.

Motes of Yorick
When gathering, players will have a chance to find a Mote of Yorrick. These small energy orbs can be used to rapidly craft (in lieu of a mass producer.) These special Motes can also be purchased for gold, but they will not be sold in the item shop. Mass Producers will continue to be sold in the item shop, as will Clockwork Harvesters.

Where are all of these gathering supplies kept?
A tool bar will appear whenever players are engaged in a gathering skill. There are 3 slots in the bar, each slot relegated for common, superior, and premium supplies. Each slot holds 2500 supplies. Each of the four gathering skills have three such slots. (All of these slots are free.) The Character Window, in the ‘Skills’ section, also displays a player’s supplies.

Additionally, we have increased the inventory amount in bags, vaults, and lockers to 1000.

What happens to all your Vim and Vim-related items?
Vim has been removed entirely from the game. When you log in, all vim-related items will no longer be in your possession, but will have been converted into a special in-game currency called Crystallized Vim Shards. You will now have a choice of what you want to spend the Shards on. If you want to buy back the same items, which have been altered to fit the new system, you can. Or, if you decide you'd rather spend your Shards on other items within the new gathering system, you can do that as well. The choice is entirely yours.

In Ardent City, up near the castle, are a group of special NPC's dressed in purple. They will exchange items with you.

Here is a list of vim-related items, and how they now fit into the new system:



Cornucopia:

Old System: Gave a small amount of Vim.
New System: Eating a cornucopia gives you a charged buff (similar to how a deluxe clockwork harvester works.) With the buff, the next time you gather you have a 90% increased chance to find a Mote of Yorick. The effect expires after a total of 3 gathers (charges). The charges scale up with the cooking/charter recipes.
Note: The Overflowing Cornucopia recipe now requires 30 Cornucopias instead of 20, but it's Charter cost was reduced from 850 to 600 tokens.

Bounty Bosses:

Old System: Killing a bounty boss in your level range restored 2 Vim.
New System: All bounty bosses (regardless of level difference) reward a crate that contains various types of supplies. The level of supplies depends on the level of the bounty boss.
Old System: Killing a bounty gave you 1 stack on a buff that stacked to 75, each stack increased your maximum Vim by 2.
New System: Bounty power works the same (1 stack per kill, stacks to 75). The buff now grants bonus chance to find supplies while gathering, and when you do find supplies, it increases the amount you find.

Bugs:

Old System: Increased max Vim.
New System: While gathering, the chance to recycle (not use your selected supply) is increased.


Herbs:

Old System: eating herbs restored Vim.
New System:
22 hour Herbs - Grants the Abundant Earth effect: While gathering, your chance to find supplies is increased. Additionally your chance to find a Mote of Yorick is increased. Lasts for 5 minutes.
2 hour Herbs - Grants the Bountiful Earth effect: While gathering, your chance to find supplies is increased. Additionally your chance to find a Mote of Yorick is increased. Lasts for 5 minutes.
Abundant Earth and Bountiful Earth may be active simultaneously.

Magical Seeds:

Old System: could be grown and consumed to increase max vim and replenish vim.
New System:
Magic Vegetables now grant a large boost to gardening experience (the harvest can then be sold to a vendor or destroyed).
Magic Spices now grant a boost to sale price (gold).
Note: Magical seeds no longer tie into the gathering or crafting system.

Cooking Potions:

Old System: Increased Vim regeneration.
Renamed: Potions of the Triad (the Legendary Three)
New System: Your luck and prosperity while gathering, crafting, and working in your village is boosted. This includes recipe cost reduction while crafting, abundant harvests while gardening, and both lucky find and bonus supplies while gathering.

Yorick's Jewelry:

Old System: Increased Max Vim
New System: You have an increased chance at finding a Mote of Yorick while gathering. Additionally, your chance to find supplies is boosted.

Xinzen Carp:

Old System: Could be consumed to give a swim speed boost and make it so you would gain Vim rather than spending it.
New System: Can now be filleted to find what the fish has been munching on. Contains a swim speed potion and various large amounts of COG coins (used to purchase gathering supplies).

Charter Rewards:

Old System: Vim potions could be purchased for various amounts of Charter Tokens.
New System: All charter vendors now sell superior gathering supplies.

{continued in part 3)

notes.title: REBORN Patch Notes - Part 2
notes.content:
(continued from part 1)

There are three different categories of supplies, and each yields a greater benefit to the player who has equipped their tools with them. However, it is not a requirement that one must equip their tools in order to gather.



Using No Supplies

Results in a 5 second gathering time
50% chance to find gathering material (e.g. fish, ore, wood, etc.)
100% chance to find 1-2 common gathering supplies for the current skill
0% chance to find supplies for another skill

Using Common Supplies

Results in a 3 second gathering time
100% chance to find gathering material (fish, ore, wood, etc.)
50% chance to find supplies for another skill (nectar, grindstones, etc.)

Using Superior Supplies

Results in a 2 second gathering time
100% chance to find gathering material (fish, ore, wood, etc)
75% chance to find gathering supplies for another skill (grindstones, nectar, etc.)

Using Premium Supplies

Results in a 1 second gathering time
100% chance to find gathering material (fish, ore, wood, etc.)
100% chance to find supplies for another skill (grindstone, worms, etc.)


Superior and Premium Supplies are fully trade-able. Common supplies, unlike the others, are not trade-able. However, every 22 hours, all players will have a stock amount of Common Supplies replenished for free, if they visit certain NPC's. These NPC's, Distributors, belong to a special group known as the Coterie of Gatherers (C.O.G. for short) and they can be found in Ardent City, Summer’s Hollow, and on the shores of Lake Kiwa, with the other members of their Coterie. C.O.G members are easily recognizable in their green robes and blazing gold emblems.

Who are the members of the C.O.G, and what do they do?

Distributors: C.O.G Distributors will serve out daily rations of supplies to all players. There is a C.O.G Distributor for Fishing, Mining, Plant Lore, and Bug Lore. Visit each of them once per day to collect your share.
Patrons: C.O.G Patrons will take Common Supplies from you in trade for C.O.G. coins. C.O.G. coins can be redeemed at a C.O.G. Quartermaster.
Quartermasters: C.O.G Quartermasters will sell you Common Supplies in exchange for varying rates of C.O.G coins.
Vendors: C.O.G. Vendors will sell Common Supplies for varying rates of gold, the official currency of the Seven Realms.


* C.O.G npc's only deal in Common Supplies, not Superior or Premium.

Motes of Yorick
When gathering, players will have a chance to find a Mote of Yorrick. These small energy orbs can be used to rapidly craft (in lieu of a mass producer.) These special Motes can also be purchased for gold, but they will not be sold in the item shop. Mass Producers will continue to be sold in the item shop, as will Clockwork Harvesters.

Where are all of these gathering supplies kept?
A tool bar will appear whenever players are engaged in a gathering skill. There are 3 slots in the bar, each slot relegated for common, superior, and premium supplies. Each slot holds 2500 supplies. Each of the four gathering skills have three such slots. (All of these slots are free.) The Character Window, in the ‘Skills’ section, also displays a player’s supplies.

Additionally, we have increased the inventory amount in bags, vaults, and lockers to 1000.

What happens to all your Vim and Vim-related items?
Vim has been removed entirely from the game. When you log in, all vim-related items will no longer be in your possession, but will have been converted into a special in-game currency called Crystallized Vim Shards. You will now have a choice of what you want to spend the Shards on. If you want to buy back the same items, which have been altered to fit the new system, you can. Or, if you decide you'd rather spend your Shards on other items within the new gathering system, you can do that as well. The choice is entirely yours.

In Ardent City, up near the castle, are a group of special NPC's dressed in purple. They will exchange items with you.

Here is a list of vim-related items, and how they now fit into the new system:



Cornucopia:

Old System: Gave a small amount of Vim.
New System: Eating a cornucopia gives you a charged buff (similar to how a deluxe clockwork harvester works.) With the buff, the next time you gather you have a 90% increased chance to find a Mote of Yorick. The effect expires after a total of 3 gathers (charges). The charges scale up with the cooking/charter recipes.
Note: The Overflowing Cornucopia recipe now requires 30 Cornucopias instead of 20, but it's Charter cost was reduced from 850 to 600 tokens.

Bounty Bosses:

Old System: Killing a bounty boss in your level range restored 2 Vim.
New System: All bounty bosses (regardless of level difference) reward a crate that contains various types of supplies. The level of supplies depends on the level of the bounty boss.
Old System: Killing a bounty gave you 1 stack on a buff that stacked to 75, each stack increased your maximum Vim by 2.
New System: Bounty power works the same (1 stack per kill, stacks to 75). The buff now grants bonus chance to find supplies while gathering, and when you do find supplies, it increases the amount you find.

Bugs:

Old System: Increased max Vim.
New System: While gathering, the chance to recycle (not use your selected supply) is increased.


Herbs:

Old System: eating herbs restored Vim.
New System:
22 hour Herbs - Grants the Abundant Earth effect: While gathering, your chance to find supplies is increased. Additionally your chance to find a Mote of Yorick is increased. Lasts for 5 minutes.
2 hour Herbs - Grants the Bountiful Earth effect: While gathering, your chance to find supplies is increased. Additionally your chance to find a Mote of Yorick is increased. Lasts for 5 minutes.

notes.title: REBORN Patch Notes - Part 1
notes.content:
Here are all the new features of Reborn summed up in detail:

New Features and Major Improvements

New Character Create
New Graphical User Interface
New ‘Personality’ animations for players’ characters
5 new starter zones
New storyline with involved quests
Voiced dialogue
New intro video with a fly-over camera
New Music
New starter outfits
New Crafting tutorials
Older zones and villages have been given artistic makeovers
‘Rebirth’: a new feature for capped players, or those over level 30


Character Create (main new features)

Voiced Narration -- A character from the story audibly prompts the player through the creation process. A sub-titles feature has also been added.
Origin Starter packs -- players are given a free supply pack of various perks, each one corresponding to the realm of origin selected.
Biography profiles -- players can choose their origin and background, as well as personalities which provide flavorful summaries of the characters they are creating.
Personality animations -- players can choose between seven new animations and ambients: Heroic, Glamorous, Thoughtful, Pious, Brutish, Fearful, and Normal.
Faces Improved -- new textures have been added, as well as a new head.
Height Option -- players can choose the height of their character.
Realm images -- Background scenes of each realm of origin are now depicted.
Villager Options -- Choices for the crafting aspect of the game have been added, and are presented as being equally important as those of the adventuring aspect. Furthermore, XP levels for chosen skills have been increased to level 5 for all new players.
House Selection -- players can now select their house styles in character create, and are provided with the information about the various housing perks.


New User Interface (main new features)

Quest Journal -- quests can be sorted by level or name, have been color-coded, can be filtered by the type of quest, and an option to view only certain quests at a time has been added.
Character Window -- Broken down into four sub-categories, the character window replaces the previous ‘outfit’ window, and now separately displays: Stats, Talents, Skills, and player Bio.
On-Screen Character Portrait -- An image of the player’s character is displayed at all times in the upper left hand corner of the screen. (Clicking on it will also open the ‘talents’ window.) Additionally, upon joining a party, pictures of all party members will also be displayed on screen.
Inventory -- items in bags are now color coded according to the category they belong to.
Shortcuts -- Shortcut icon tabs have been added on screen for the quest journal, friends lists, achievements, and the character window. These have all been removed from the ‘Menu’ tab.
Quest tracking bar -- the icons for the five quests being tracked are now in upper corner of screen, aligned horizontally instead of vertically.
Character select screen -- new background images based upon a player’s origin selection for their character now appear on the select page.


New zones, New quests, and New Tutorials

5 brand new zones -- Ethos Island, Lower Ethos Island, Cronk Island, The Briny Caverns, and the Underground Sanctum. (The now much-changed town of Summer’s Hollow has moved, and can be found on Ethos Island.)
 Fly-cam video -- an introductory video takes the player on a brief tour of Ethos Island before setting them down in front of Summer’s Hollow.
New Quests -- A series of lengthy, story-driven quests will keep players busy in all the new zones.
Voiced Dialogue -- Over 60 different NPC’s in the new zones have speaking parts.
New ‘Story Icon’ -- A purple exclamation mark over an NPC now indicates that the quest is part of the main storyline. (Yellow exclamation marks indicate side quests.)
An Improved Crafting/Gathering Tutorial -- Extensive tutorials for all 8 skills have been added in the new zones.


Old Zone Makeovers

Artistic Touch-ups to old zones -- Ardent City, Ardent Castle, Lady’s Lake, Elk’s Meadow, Memorial Pond, Vinton, Mounds, Moonglade, Oak Valley, Kingsport, Southern Coast, Shadow's Den and Villages have all been enhanced.


'Rebirth' - A feature which enables players at level 30 or above to begin anew with special advantages

Players can return to level 1, and will be given 5 bonus talent points.
Players will keep all of their prior crafting skills, elder levels, items, bags, gnogmentation packs, achievements, travel pad locations, and portal keys they earned before rebirthing.
Players will lose all prior combat levels. All quest status,’ progress, and completions will be reset, as well as bounties and kill counts. All talents will be reset, and any talent points gained by leveling will also be lost. However, players will keep any talent points received for performing the rebirth.
In addition to the five bonus talent points given, players will also receive a special hero experience bonus that stacks with all normal experience boosts. This bonus scales with level, becoming increasingly powerful upwards of a 400% boost.
Players who undergo the rebirthing process will also receive a special emblem displayed in their player cameo text, which will indicate how many times they have been reborn.

Please note: at this time, such items as Yorick's Gathering Hat, Cheetah Boots, and Golden Winged Helm will lose their proficiencies after a player performs a Rebirth. However, we will be implementing tech in several weeks time, which will ensure that the proficiencies on the items will remain.

A new gathering system

How does it work?

Gathering from any resource requires a specific tool. Fishing requires a pole. Mining requires a pick-axe, Wood, fruit, and mushroom picking require a scythe. Bug collecting requires a magnifying glass. Each tool can be equipped with unique supplies which provide special advantages to the gatherer. These supplies are found in the different gathering nodes within the world, and are interdependent upon each other, thereby forming a circle of life.


Mining supplies can be gained while fishing and mining.
Plant Lore supplies can be gained while mining and doing plant gathering.
Bug Lore supplies can be gained while doing Plant Lore, and collecting bugs.
Fishing supplies can be gained while doing Bug Lore and fishing.

Examples of supplies:

Grindstones aid in plant lore, and can be used to sharpen scythes.
Fishing Worms aid in fishing, and act as tantalizing bait.
Natural oils aid in mining, and can improve the metal of the pick-axe.
Nectar aids in the collection of bugs.


(continued in part 2)

notes.title: Villagers & Heroes: REBORN will launch on Monday, June 8th!
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/reborn_splash_launchdate_steam.jpg

Mad Otter Games is very excited to announce the release date of Villagers and Heroes: REBORN, the latest in a long line of changes that brings a whole new life to the game. Not only can veteran players find exciting new content and features with this major expansion, but we have re-designed the entire game and especially the starter zone to make those first several hours in the game more exciting and immersive.

REBORN will launch on Monday, June 8th, at 11 am Eastern / 8 am Pacific.

REBORN includes these major new improvements:


A Mystery to Solve - Who is the Malicious Miscreant, and why are citizens of Summer's Hollow mysteriously disappearing?
The Circle of Life - An all new gathering supply system that completely replaces the unpopular ENERGY / Vim system formerly featured in the game.  Worms for fishing, Nectar for bug collecting, Grind Stones for your plant sickle, etc.
Voice Acting and Musical Score - Professional voice actors for the major quests in the game
Complete Face Lift - Literally and otherwise- most of the world has been completely redone with new artwork (models and painted texture), completely new User Interface, and new character facial choices have been added.
Wider Breadth of Choices for your Character - Apart from choosing your appearance and class specialization, you can now choose your personality type (complete with appropriate body pose), your origin, and your skills as a villager.
Be Reborn! Enter the Temple of Rebirth to unlearn all your combat skills and start anew, but this time with the advantage of more skills to unlock, and without losing all of your character’s knowledge of gathering, crafting, gear and items, and greatly accelerated learning!


More information on REBORN can be found at www.vhreborn.com or the Steam Community page of the game.

notes.title: REBORN: The Rebirth ritual
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/5_header.png 

Relive your past! In Villagers & Heroes: Reborn, your character can undergo several Rebirths - where they return to level one and get to re-experience the game, but keeping all valuables and non-combat skill levels. Characters who have undergone a Rebirth will also receive extra talent points and a boost to gained combat XP. 

Perform the ritual...
To perform a Rebirth you must make it to the Temple of Rebirth, where the mysterious ways of reliving your life are revealed. If you pass the tests of the ritual, you are Reborn.

This ritual can be performed four times - at level 30, 45, 60 and 75. Each time further stat points are granted, culminating in a bonus of 20 points if you have been reborn all four times.

...and everyone will see
Characters who have undergone a Rebirth will have special ornaments attached to their portraits - so others can always tell that you have undergone the Ritual.

Your ornaments grow more beautiful and intricate with each Rebirth, so you can finally wear the insigina of ultimate wisdom. 

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/otin.png

Everything is reborn.
There is much, much more to see in Villagers & Heroes: Reborn - but that is for you to discover! Stay tuned as we get closer to the release of this brand new chapter of Villagers & Heroes history. See you in the Seven Realms!

notes.title: REBORN: Graphics, zones and UI overhaul
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/4_header.png 

Old Ardent remade! In Reborn, existing areas of the game have been remade to look more interesting, more believable and more atmospheric. Take a look below at just a few examples of how Reborn brings new life to old regions of Ardent!

(old versions on the left)

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/comparison1.png

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/comparison2.png

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/comparison3.png

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/comparison4.png

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/comparison5.png


New User Interface
The UI of Reborn has been redesigned from the ground up, retailored to provide a faster and more immersive experience. Below can be seen just a few examples of redesigned areas of the UI, and how they make the game easier and more fun to play. 


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/character.png
Stats, skills, talents & bio
Find all the information on your character in one place with the new Character window! Check on your stats, your talents, your equipment and your skills - even your personal biography - all in a single spot.
And there's more! Apart from bringing everything together, there are also far more stats shown, color coding of equipped items, undoable talents, better tracking of skill levels, and much more. 


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/inventory.png
Inventory
Manage your items and equipment easier than ever before! Reborn's redesigned inventory now color codes all your items. Can't find that enormously rare sword you found yesterday? It's easily located! Looking for all your less valuable items? Easy to sort out!
The inventory is also larger in size, increasing the space between item slots and making it less easier to select just the item you want. 


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/logbook.png
Quests and bounties
Reborn features a completely new Logbook to track your quests - no longer will you have to scroll through an endlessly long list to find the quest you need! Quest can now be sorted and filtered however you wish. View only main quests, hide completed quests, sort quests alphabetically - and much more. There is also much more space to read quest descriptions, making it much easier to browse through large, complex quests. 


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/crafting.png
Crafting
Crafting is made much easier with a new, redesigned crafting window. Sort based on only specific classes, filter by min and max level, and see more information about what you want to craft. The new crafting window also makes it much easier to choose exactly the amount of items you want to craft with a new, far more precise slider. 


And much more!
This is only a small preview of the new UI - much more is included in Reborn. See a more informative and polished HUD, a beautiful new way to choose between your characters, new loading screens for all hundreds of zones in the game, and much, much more.

notes.title: REBORN: Graphics, zones and UI overhaul
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/4_header.png 

Old Ardent remade! In Reborn, existing areas of the game have been remade to look more interesting, more believable and more atmospheric. Take a look below at just a few examples of how Reborn brings new life to old regions of Ardent!

(old versions on the left)

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/comparison1.png

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/comparison2.png

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/comparison3.png

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/comparison4.png

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/comparison5.png


New User Interface
The UI of Reborn has been redesigned from the ground up, retailored to provide a faster and more immersive experience. Below can be seen just a few examples of redesigned areas of the UI, and how they make the game easier and more fun to play. 


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/character.png
Stats, skills, talents & bio
Find all the information on your character in one place with the new Character window! Check on your stats, your talents, your equipment and your skills - even your personal biography - all in a single spot.
And there's more! Apart from bringing everything together, there are also far more stats shown, color coding of equipped items, undoable talents, better tracking of skill levels, and much more. 


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/inventory.png
Inventory
Manage your items and equipment easier than ever before! Reborn's redesigned inventory now color codes all your items. Can't find that enormously rare sword you found yesterday? It's easily located! Looking for all your less valuable items? Easy to sort out!
The inventory is also larger in size, increasing the space between item slots and making it less easier to select just the item you want. 


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/logbook.png
Quests and bounties
Reborn features a completely new Logbook to track your quests - no longer will you have to scroll through an endlessly long list to find the quest you need! Quest can now be sorted and filtered however you wish. View only main quests, hide completed quests, sort quests alphabetically - and much more. There is also much more space to read quest descriptions, making it much easier to browse through large, complex quests. 


https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/crafting.png
Crafting
Crafting is made much easier with a new, redesigned crafting window. Sort based on only specific classes, filter by min and max level, and see more information about what you want to craft. The new crafting window also makes it much easier to choose exactly the amount of items you want to craft with a new, far more precise slider. 


And much more!
This is only a small preview of the new UI - much more is included in Reborn. See a more informative and polished HUD, a beautiful new way to choose between your characters, new loading screens for all hundreds of zones in the game, and much, much more.

notes.title: REBORN: No more energy - and a new way to gather and craft
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/3_header.png 

Be one with the land! Reborn brings the removal of the old energy mechanic known as Vim - and in its place is a gathering system centered around natural ways to gather and craft.

Players who own existing Vim-related items will be able to trade them in for powerful in-game rewards - rest assured no matter how much time or money you have invested into the Vim mechanic, it will not be lost.

At the heart of the new system are supplies - natural supplies which, when used together with a gathering tool, will make you gather faster and find better materials. There are four kinds of supplies, one for each gathering skill:

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/supplies.png

Find supplies by gathering
Supplies are found as you gather - gathering one kind of resource gives you the supplies you need to gather another. Fishing Worms, for instance, can be found by searching for bugs, which in turn uses Nectar that can be found while harvesting plants. In addition to this, sometimes you find supplies for the kind of gathering you are currently doing - so you may also find Fishing Worms by fishing, Nectar while collecting bugs, and so on. See how it works for each skill below! 

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/circleoflife.png

Some supplies are better than others
All supplies come in three different rarities. Since you can also gather with no supplies if you choose to, this means that there are four different ways of gathering:

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/rarities.png

Trade and exchange supplies
Superior and Premium supplies are always tradeable with other players. Common supplies are not, but they can still be traded with certain NPCs - the Coterie of Gatherers, or C.O.G. for short. There are several kinds of C.O.G. members - take a look at all of them below! 

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/cog.png

Stay Tuned...
Over the next few weeks, many more new features for Villagers and Heroes: Reborn will be announced.  This is only the beginning of the journey.

notes.title: REBORN: New lands to explore
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/2_header.png 

Welcome to Ethos Island! Uncover the secrets of this exotic land in an immersive new storyline where challenging quests will take players into five new regions, each area filled with countless locations to explore, dangerous foes to battle, and a dark mystery in need of solving.

Take a closer look at all the new content at the Villagers and Heroes: Reborn expansion website.

Uncover the mystery
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/story.png

A mysterious villain. An insidious spell. Time is running out for the citizens of Summer’s Hollow! A hero is needed, someone with the bravery and the smarts to unravel a beguiling whodunit.

Be that hero, and embark upon a series of challenging quests, rich with lore and rife with danger. Unmask and defeat the evil being who is terrorizing the land, and save the townspeople before it is too late.


Ethos Island

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/zones_ethosisland.gif

Summer’s Hollow, a bustling town of trade and merriment, is the beating heart of the island, though many adore the tranquil scenery of nearby Gandymeade Grove. But it is to the town that people flock, especially now, when the lavish yearly festival is in full swing. Many hope to catch a glimpse of the most famous actress in all of the Seven Realms, Ms. Clementine DeClancy. 

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/zones_small_ethosisland.gif


Lower Ethos Island

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/zones_lowerethosisland.gif

Golden meadows, a lush fen, and expansive farmlands abound. But the dedicated homesteaders of this peaceful region are now in a state of hysteria, fearful that the villain known only as ‘The Malicious Miscreant’ will destroy all they have worked for, and inflict the darkness of the Shadow Years upon the world again. 

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/zones_small_lowerethosisland.gif


Cronk Island

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/zones_cronkisland.gif

A foul chunk of diseased rock, inhabited only by ghastly beasts and deranged outcasts. But this place of whispers and screams harbors a vital secret, one well shrouded with time. It will take a truly courageous hero to unlock the mysteries of so abhorrent an island. 

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/zones_small_cronkisland.gif


Briny Caverns

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/zones_brinycaverns.gif

This maze of watery tunnels and mossy caves where emerald waterfalls and eerie wonders abound, is home to both creatures of light and of the dark. It is a ghostly boat which will aid those in need of answers, but to where it sails, few have returned from. 

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/Steam/zones_small_brinycaverns.gif


Stay Tuned...
Over the next few weeks, many more new features for Villagers and Heroes: Reborn will be announced.  This is only the beginning of the journey.

notes.title: REBORN: New Character Create
notes.content:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/1_header.png 

Your story begins...with an all new and improved character create! Construct the hero you want to be! Pick from a vast array of character personalities, models, and pick the origin story that best fits your character!

Dive deep into the plethora of new character create features at the Villagers and Heroes: Reborn expansion website.

Choose Your Background...
Tweak every detail of your character! Choose between a huge amount of appearances and nine distinct personalities - everything weaves into a dynamic backstory that evolves as your character does, with endless outcomes.

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/1_image_1.png


...And Your Realm
Follow the legacy of your ancestors! Your realm of origin shapes your character's backstory, gives you different equipment in the game, and changes how you appear to others. All of the Seven Realms are yours to choose from:
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/1_image_2.png

Be a Hero...
Excel at anything! Become a strong warrior, a powerful wizard, an agile hunter or a wise priest - and specialize yourself further by choosing starting gear that lets you focus into one of the eight distinct paths:

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/1_image_3.png

...And a Villager
Craft your future! Start out as an amazing fisher, a brilliant cook, a proficient smith or anything else you desire - and decide how you want to live by choosing a house theme. Here are just a few examples of ways you can improve your character from the beginning:

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/7821237/Promotional/Reborn/1_image_4.png

Stay Tuned...
Over the next few weeks, many more new features for Villagers and Heroes: Reborn will be announced.  This is only the beginning of the journey.

notes.title: English Patchnotes 2.40.4 - Thursday February 19 2015
notes.content:
Full Release Notes 
    May you all have visions of sugar-plums dancing in your heads! 

    This patch has a new holiday event zone, "Sugarsweet Summit", a new outfit, bug fixes, and a few improvements.

    Improvements 

        Sugarsweet Summit, a new event zone, is up now.
        Improved Advanced Lighting so it takes up less memory, which should hopefully make it faster and less prone to crashes. (With Advanced Lighting on, in Ardent this saves about 200 Megs!)
        Removed the "Friend All" pop up that occurs when moving into a village (due to popular request).
        Spirit Regeneration when out of combat is a little slower than before.
        Changed Fishing and Bug Collecting so they take nearly the same amount of time to do as Mining and Plants. (hopefully) reduced the time to pet and feed ranching animals (untested).
        The effects section on tooltips for loot and gatherables will now be smaller, but will expand after hover for a second or two. This should make tooltips for gatherables less annoying when gathering many items.
        Monsters and players using click-to-move are better now at avoiding obstacles.
        We made the coin loot stacks a little more visible.
        Boosted the drop rate of the Pyrrick Acorn.




    Bug Fixes 

        Hopefully fixed a gnogmentation bug causing certain items to be shown as empty, even though they have talents attached.
        Fixed underwater fog in advanced lighting mode.
        Cleaned up some boss exclamations
        Made friendlies so they cannot enter Aegis.
        Hopefully fixed bug causing players to get stuck in a weird "dead" state requiring a relog to fix.
        Hopefully fixed the cause of many cases of getting permanently stuck at 0% loading in a zone.
        Hopefully fixed a very rare bug that could prevent mail from being viewed.
        Fixed: Players can't remove other players from friends list nor guild if their name contains an umlaut ( ä, ü, and ö )
        Fixed a bug where a player could close the game while teleporting, and effectively cancel the teleport.
        Fixed: /cinfo and /kick aren't working with names with ä,ü,ö,ß

notes.title: To our Brazilian Players - Novo Servidor do Villagers and Heroes no Brasil
notes.content:
Olá comunidade,

Viemos anunciar uma série de mudanças e melhorias para o Villagers and Heroes Brasil. Somos a empresa Looki responsável pela adminsitração e gestão de diversos jogos de web conhecidos internacionalmente, como Desert Operations, Empire Universe 3 e muitos outros e há uns meses fechamos parceria com a Mad Otter para gerenciarmos o Villagers and Heroes Brasil, tranzendo assim um novo servidor. Com essa mudança teremos que migrar todas as contas para o novo servidor melhorando a jogabilidade. A migração foi terminada com sucesso.

Com a migração do servidor brasileiro para os servidores da Looki, jogadores que acessam o jogo via STEAM devem proceder da seguinte forma para acessar ao novo servidor:

1. clicar com o botão direito do mouse no nome do jogo e acessar propriedades:

http://www.villagersandheroes.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/vh_steam021.png

 2. Em idioma, escolha o idioma português:

http://www.villagersandheroes.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/vh_steam01.png

A partir disto, seu cliente STEAM se sincronizará com o novo servidor e você poderá acessar ao servidor BR.

Quem tiver qualquer dúvida envie um ticket para o suporte através desse link: Suporte

A página do jogo continará sendo a mesma e estaremos postando lá, e também no fórum, todas as informações e mudanças que ocorrer no servidor brasileiro.

Link da página do jogo: Página do Jogo

Link do fórum: Fórum

notes.title: Sugarsweet Summit
notes.content:
A deliciously intoxicating special event zone is soon to be arriving in Ardent!  
http://i.imgur.com/XqEECxN.jpg
Players, many clad in shiny new cupid wings, but armed with the sturdiest of weapons, will be exploring the pink hills and rolling glens of Sugarsweet Summit -- a place where frighteningly plump ne’er-do-wells lurk inside of candy-coated caverns and are ready to pounce on all who disturb their feeding frenzies.
http://i.imgur.com/Gki1HRb.jpg?1
Sugarsweet Summit offers players of all levels the chance to reap vast rewards and goodies.  For the combat inclined, 6 formidable Elder Bosses await.  Be warned though, these challenging foes are not for the faint of heart and will surely require a large party of heroes to take them down.  And for our craft-loving players, the Summit offers much to do in the way of multiple daily quests, not to mention the return of our beloved February friends, Valentino and Valentina.

What else does Sugarsweet Summit possess?  (Pssst!  Lolly-Grams anyone?)  Here’s just a few of the things this delightful zone will have to offer:

An event-themed weapon pack with a brand new special cosmetic feat

5 brand new outfits in the item shop, and 3 special outfits in the event zone only

Cupid Wings

New feature:  Lolly-Grams!  Create a lolly gram with a special custom note, and send it to your friend with a gift attached

New feature: ‘Echo Bounty.’ Killing an elder boss on Sugarsweet Summit gives you great rewards once per day. In addition, players can kill the boss again for an echo bounty reward. Echo bounty rewards can be earned any number of times per day.

Free goodies everywhere!

http://i.imgur.com/IaFyG6b.jpg?1

Get ready to swoon and slay, gorge on goodies, and most of all, enjoy the company of your friends in this fun-filled event zone.  See you all soon in Sugarsweet Summit!

http://i.imgur.com/Gki1HRb.jpg?1
Sugarsweet Summit offers players of all levels the chance to reap vast rewards and goodies.  For the combat inclined, 6 formidable Elder Bosses await.  Be warned though, these challenging foes are not for the faint of heart and will surely require a large party of heroes to take them down.  And for our craft-loving players, the Summit offers much to do in the way of multiple daily quests, not to mention the return of our beloved February friends, Valentino and Valentina.

What else does Sugarsweet Summit possess?  (Pssst!  Lolly-Grams anyone?)  Here’s just a few of the things this delightful zone will have to offer:

An event-themed weapon pack with a brand new special cosmetic feat

5 brand new outfits in the item shop, and 3 special outfits in the event zone only

Cupid Wings

New feature:  Lolly-Grams!  Create a lolly gram with a special custom note, and send it to your friend with a gift attached

New feature: ‘Echo Bounty.’ Killing an elder boss on Sugarsweet Summit gives you great rewards once per day. In addition, players can kill the boss again for an echo bounty reward. Echo bounty rewards can be earned any number of times per day.

Free goodies everywhere!

http://i.imgur.com/IaFyG6b.jpg?1

Get ready to swoon and slay, gorge on goodies, and most of all, enjoy the company of your friends in this fun-filled event zone.  See you all soon in Sugarsweet Summit!

notes.title: Patch 2.34 - A lot has changed since April...
notes.content:
We have been listening! See what has been improved in Villagers and Heroes!

http://i.imgur.com/JYHwlwP.png?1

What has changed since the game launched on Steam in April?

In short:
Much improved fluid, action-oriented combat
Removal of the pay for energy mechanic
A vast improvement on our social features and UI
The addition of rolling, both as a fun movement option, but also as a dodging game mechanic
Spell fusions, and a focus on teamwork and party mechanics
Crash fixes, bug fixes, faster download
More ambient sounds like footsteps
More emotes like dancing
And a whole slew of new content, including new end game content, revamped tutorials, and new events

And all of these changes were based on feedback from you the players! We have been listening!

Since launching on Steam five months ago, we’ve taken the excellent suggestions and feedback provided by all of our users, and vastly improved our game as a result.  Our latest build, Sands of the Equinox 2.34, while featuring an intoxicating new event with an array of desert themed bosses, bounties, and loot, is also characterized by a number of other changes we’ve made with regards to basic game mechanics and style of play – changes that players of any level, high or low, will surely find exciting.

For the adventurously inclined, you’ll be thrilled to discover that we’ve revamped our entire combat system so that it’s not only more fluid and responsive, but it now includes a variety of dynamic new actions and movements -- aerial acrobatics, tucking and rolling, agile strafing, increased acceleration while attacking foes, and more. With the addition of tucking and rolling also comes the ability to dodge, time your defense, tuck and roll out of the way dodging the coming onslaught. We also spent a large portion of time fine tuning our classes, improving visual and audio effects, adding new spells and feats, and finally adding spell fusions, where party members can fuse their feats and spells with one another, creating more powerful and devastating effects. 

And for our craft loving players, because we firmly believe that Villagers and Heroes should be accessible to all users alike, we have completely removed the ‘Pay-for-Energy’ mechanic from within our game.  Our new system, one which allows for ‘Vim’ to be naturally replenished by crafters in all manner of different ways, contains a plethora of ways to engage with, strategize about, and take advantage of.  Thus, players can advance in crafting more rapidly through savvy gameplay and strategy.

Patch 2.34 marks an exciting turn for us!  Thanks to the invaluable feedback from our community, modifications, great and small, have been made across the board:  players can now dance and sit, and listen to the sound of their own running footsteps as they explore secret new areas in the lower zones where an array of entertaining surprises now await.  High level players will not only revel in the addition of fourteen brand new zones with challenging quest chains to unravel, but we’ve also included an end game mechanic which will hereafter keep players consistently engaged even after reaching level cap.  Moreover, players of all levels will be happy to find that we’ve revamped our housing policies, fixed countless bugs, greatly sped up the download time of the game, added new feats and spells, not to mention an entire upgrade on all of our social features, and two special event zones concurrently running.  And that’s just the short list of changes we’ve made…

So thank you, new players and veteran players alike!  Our game is better because of you all.  But don’t take our word for it.  Experience Sands of the Equinox 2.34 for yourselves.   We’ve been listening, and you won’t be disappointed. 

If you want the details of what has changed, check out our patch notes:

Patch 2.33.6 is now live.

notes.title: Spring Mini-Game Event
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/qubXaPH.jpg

 http://i.imgur.com/Mzd70Ou.jpg	 


Have you ever been in this situation?

    You’re staring deep into your vaults, have been for hours, but see only the same old tedious hats and helms, and dusty robes and armors that have been hanging there for too many seasons to count. All around you it’s springtime -- new sights, sounds, and colors abound. But not in your vault, which is as sparkly as a gloomy Pyrron dungeon.

    You happen to catch sight of your reflection -- wrinkled tunic, faded boots, droopy belt -- and your mood improves not at all. For the hundredth time, you wearily think it again: I simply have NOTHING to wear.

    Well, cheer up. We can help you. The legendary fashion designer himself, Adamo Otteramo, recently traveled these parts and left behind, in the hands of his most trusted tailors and seamstresses, the latest creations from his dazzling new spring collection. But it is Adamo’s wish that these rare outfits, divinely elegant, be given to those only worthy enough to wear such finery.

    Adamo values intellect and adventurous spirit. As such, he has instructed his assistants to hide themselves in remote locations throughout the land, exceedingly unusual spots that only the bravest of explorers will ever have a hope of finding. Adamo’s assistants, once located, will then test the explorers further, by asking them a single riddle pertaining to this mystical land in which we all dwell.

    But beware! Adamo loathes multiple choice, nor is he partial to the policy of unlimited guesses. However, as a fashion designer he does understand that it would be unfair if his garments came in only one size, which is why he has given three outfits, of different sizes, to his assistants: Small (levels 1-20), Medium (levels 21-40), and Large (levels 41-70.) The explorers then should seek out those parts of the land most befitting of their size.

    The first explorer to correctly answer the riddle in their level bracket will win Adamo’s latest fashion creation! (Each of the three level brackets will have a different riddle.) There will be three winners on every server, unless of course a riddle goes unsolved. In that case, none may claim that particular garment. (Adamo feels strongly about this.)

    Event Details and Rules

    • At the given time, all participating players will congregate in Ardent. A ‘tournament guide’ will then make an announcement:

    * Players of levels 1-20 will be given the name of the specific zone in which to look for Adamo’s hidden assistant.
    * Players of levels 21-40 will be given the name of the specific zone in which to look for Adamo’s hidden assistant.
    * Players of levels 41-70 will be given the name of the specific zone in which to look for Adamo’s hidden assistant.

    • When the names of the three zones have all been revealed, a time clock will be set for one hour. Players will travel to their designated zones and search for the hidden assistants.

    • Adamo’s three assistants will be clearly labeled, so there will be no confusing them with other players.

    • Once a player has found Adamo’s hidden assistant, the following procedure will take place:

    * Adamo’s assistant will first verify that the player is in the appropriate zone for their level. If so, the assistant will then invite the player into a private party chat line.
    * The assistant will tell the player the riddle, but will supply them with no other information. (No hints, no clues, nothing.)
    * The player will then be removed from the private party chat line, and can deliberate on the riddle for however long they like. But remember, the clock is ticking!
    * When player is ready to make their guess, they will return to Adamo’s assistant. Player will then invite the assistant into a private party chat line, and make their guess.
    * Player is only allowed one opportunity to guess and the spelling of the answer must be correct. There are no second chances.
    * If player answers the riddle correctly, they will be deemed the winner of the prize, and that particular section level of the tournament, from then on, will be closed.
    * An announcement will be posted on the forums, alerting all players to this. The tournament guide in Ardent will also announce whenever a riddle has been solved.
    * Once a section has been closed, that assistant will then position themselves near the portal of the zone, and routinely announce that the section is now closed.

    • When the hour is up, the mini-game event is over and no more prizes will be handed out, at all.

    • WHISPERING IS NOT ALLOWED. (We are using the honor system and hope you will abide by it.)

    • Players may only claim prizes that are in their level bracket. For example, a level 50 player may not participate in the level 1-20 section of the tournament.

    • The use of alts is allowed, provided the alt is appropriate to the level bracket. For example, if your main toon answers a riddle incorrectly, you may try for other sections of the tournament with your alt. OR, if your alt happens to be of the same level as your main, you do have an opportunity to make a second guess at the same riddle.

    • On each server, all of Adamo’s assistants will be hidden in the exact same location, and will ask the exact same riddle.

    • The tournament guide in Ardent will be on hand to provide updates, or direct late players to their appropriate level zones, or answer any questions regarding the rules of the event. However, the guide in Ardent will not repeat riddles. Only Adamo’s assistants will ask the riddles, and will repeat them to players as needed.

    • If a player has inadvertently gone to the wrong zone bracket and asks for the riddle, Adamo’s assistant will direct them to the appropriate zone.

    This mini-game event will take place on Sunday, May 25. The start time is:

    • Germany – 7pm (CEST)
    • UK – 6pm (BST)
    • US -- 10am (PDT) 1pm (EDT)
    • Brazil – 2pm (BRT)

    Please visit this link to find your exact time zone for the event:  Here 

    There are many who do not visit the forums regularly, so please tell all your friends and guild mates about the event via in-game email.

    Good luck, and hope to see you all there!

notes.title: Release Notes for 2.27.3
notes.content:
Notes to the Players 
This build is a response to all the player comments. Briefly, the major fixes are:

Summer’s Hollow and Oak Valley were made more interesting and unique, and include some special challenges and easter eggs.
We improved the controls for movement, the camera, and combat to be snappier and more responsive. But, we're just getting started! More to come.
Multiple players can now use the same crafting station.
We added VSynch.


We did not make the changes to Energy yet, but the change will come in the next build.

Stay tuned-- lots more great stuff in the coming weeks. 

Improvements 

Summer's Hollow and Oak Valley were completely reworked: new monsters (Goblins and Felcats instead of wolves), new and more interesting Quest dialog that matches the quirky and funny style of the game, and other secret stuff…
Improvements to movement and camera control

We improved the walking, running, and strafing animations.
A & D keys strafe while the right mouse button is held down.
Click-to-move now defaults to off.
Right mouse button no longer causes the character to change direction except while moving with WASD or mouse-drive.
Right mouse button no longer breaks auto-run.
Rotation to a target or move location is now instant and doesn't prevent attacks.
Don't accelerate or decelerate during click-to-move or moving towards target, and reduce over-running.
WASD is now more sensitive and now has a "ramp up" time, instead of immediately moving at full speed.

Combat Improvements

Fixed: The player effect bar sometimes 'blinks' out.
Effect icons now will appear instantly.
Fixed: when switching targets, the effect bar sometimes carries over for upwards of 3-5 seconds.
Feat/Spell Button flash is much shorter now.
Fixed a bug causing effect icons to occasionally briefly disappear.
Combat bar now pops up instantly if combat starts or a feat is used.
Cameo orb of players and NPCs now appears instantly instead of after a few second's delay.

We renamed "Sheep Pen" to "Animal Pen"
We added support for Vertical Sync. There is now an option in Settings->Display->Miscellaneous Options->Vertical Sync to turn it on.
We cleaned up Sapphira's Lament, reducing some of the thicker populations of mobs
Belts and gloves now have unique 3d loot objects
The depths got a slight cosmetic touch up with some new torches
The warrior spell Huzzah was cosmetically improved to no longer show green
Enemy Hill Giants bash spell had its damage slightly reduced and its duration reduced.
The "Display" tab in Settings has been renamed "Options" to better match.
There is now a button to send bug reports in the "Display" tab in Settings.
Players who are inactive for 30 minutes will be exited to the Character Select screen.
We removed "Marty" in Ardent who was using the anvil (and taking up space!).
We moved Aldispos.
Strength of the Bear buff now has a 3 minute duration
In-game spirit essence models are now disabled by default.
House Rent: make it so that if the player's account is less than 1 week old, they can rent for 5 days, and prepay for up to 5 days from the current day at any time during that week. If account is 1-2 weeks old, it's 10 days. After 2 weeks, it's like it was before...up to a month prepay, and 2 weeks on purchase. Also there is no foreclosure grace period until 2 weeks.
Multiple characters can now craft at the same anvil, cooking pot, or other crafting node.
Settings changes should no longer be lost when the game crashes.
We Increased XP tables from level 1-10 slightly so players don’t level up so quickly
We removed the series of leveling gift bags and have replaced them with small named gift packs that certain NPCs in Oak Valley give to players. In general players get about the same amount of goods, but they get them at better times rather than all at the end.
All elder parts now have a unique 3D icon to show what they are (instead of the old pyramids)
When Arcron performs an elder restoration, there is now a fancy lightshow.
Charters of all levels now give Charter Tokens 
We made several lighting fixes in Pyrron zones
We tweaked some of the sizes of the monster part 3d loot.
The following negative effects are now curable by the priests cure spell: Confuse, Bewildering Blast, Spore Cloud, Spore Blast, Condemn, Malevolent Roots, Shadow Howl, Frightful Bite, Fear, Paralyzing Fear, Chilling Cry, Doom
Players can now walk beneath Pyrrus legs in Pyrron Courtyard. 


 Bugs Fixed 

Fixed: Some Steam Players can't buy crowns. We need to detect if the user does not have the overlay turned on, and if so, post a pop-up to explain what they need to do to enable the Steam Overlay, as well as redirect to the Steam website to complete the purchase.
We fixed a bug causing strafing and moving backwards to sometimes start off not matching camera direction.
Fixed: You are at -52 -253 68 in Shadow Fated Vega, The water is transparent in this location.
Fixed: Level 70 Decoction - making 1 level 70 decoction requires 3 level 65 decoctions and 1 water.
Fixed: We added some tech to hopefully speed up frame rate in The undercroft.
Fixed a bug that was causing Venom of the Serpent to not look correct when cast.
We fixed a bug that caused warrior mobs who cast Huzzah to not be able to attack
We fixed a bug causing signs to show nothing.
The game will now repair itself if it detects it has been corrupted.
We fixed a bug causing the game to freeze while sending a bug report (ironic, we know!)


 The following bugs were hot-fixed last week 

We fixed a bug preventing guild players from getting a house in their guild village.
Exception typo: server grabbing prefs from db
Fixed a bug with the Quest log that made it not work for some people at the start of the game.
We Reduced the respawn times of monsters in the first two zones.
We balanced the early zones with more channels so they can accommodate a larger influx of players
We fixed a crash bug caused by some assets not being properly unzipped. This was the second most common crash bug. This would cause the game to crash when launching.
We improved patcher/launcher download rates. It should no longer be too slow to download.
We fixed a bug that prevented certain Brazilian players from signing in from Steam.
We fixed a very rare bug that caused DLC items to sometimes not be granted immediately. NOTE: Players who did not get their items initially will automatically receive them now.


 Bugs We Cannot Reproduce (or we need more information) 

“Having problems with showing Cheery the signet from Shangri. It won't work either having ring in bag or on me. The dialogue box does not change either way. Plz could you help.”
“Vega not giving xp for players within 10 lvls only for 5 lvls”

notes.title: Release Notes for 2.27.3
notes.content:
Notes to the Players 
This build is a response to all the player comments. Briefly, the major fixes are:

Summer’s Hollow and Oak Valley were made more interesting and unique, and include some special challenges and easter eggs.
We improved the controls for movement, the camera, and combat to be snappier and more responsive. But, we're just getting started! More to come.
Multiple players can now use the same crafting station.
We added VSynch.


We did not make the changes to Energy yet, but the change will come in the next build.

Stay tuned-- lots more great stuff in the coming weeks. 

Improvements 

Summer's Hollow and Oak Valley were completely reworked: new monsters (Goblins and Felcats instead of wolves), new and more interesting Quest dialog that matches the quirky and funny style of the game, and other secret stuff…
Improvements to movement and camera control

We improved the walking, running, and strafing animations.
A & D keys strafe while the right mouse button is held down.
Click-to-move now defaults to off.
Right mouse button no longer causes the character to change direction except while moving with WASD or mouse-drive.
Right mouse button no longer breaks auto-run.
Rotation to a target or move location is now instant and doesn't prevent attacks.
Don't accelerate or decelerate during click-to-move or moving towards target, and reduce over-running.
WASD is now more sensitive and now has a "ramp up" time, instead of immediately moving at full speed.

Combat Improvements

Fixed: The player effect bar sometimes 'blinks' out.
Effect icons now will appear instantly.
Fixed: when switching targets, the effect bar sometimes carries over for upwards of 3-5 seconds.
Feat/Spell Button flash is much shorter now.
Fixed a bug causing effect icons to occasionally briefly disappear.
Combat bar now pops up instantly if combat starts or a feat is used.
Cameo orb of players and NPCs now appears instantly instead of after a few second's delay.

We renamed "Sheep Pen" to "Animal Pen"
We added support for Vertical Sync. There is now an option in Settings->Display->Miscellaneous Options->Vertical Sync to turn it on.
We cleaned up Sapphira's Lament, reducing some of the thicker populations of mobs
Belts and gloves now have unique 3d loot objects
The depths got a slight cosmetic touch up with some new torches
The warrior spell Huzzah was cosmetically improved to no longer show green
Enemy Hill Giants bash spell had its damage slightly reduced and its duration reduced.
The "Display" tab in Settings has been renamed "Options" to better match.
There is now a button to send bug reports in the "Display" tab in Settings.
Players who are inactive for 30 minutes will be exited to the Character Select screen.
We removed "Marty" in Ardent who was using the anvil (and taking up space!).
We moved Aldispos.
Strength of the Bear buff now has a 3 minute duration
In-game spirit essence models are now disabled by default.
House Rent: make it so that if the player's account is less than 1 week old, they can rent for 5 days, and prepay for up to 5 days from the current day at any time during that week. If account is 1-2 weeks old, it's 10 days. After 2 weeks, it's like it was before...up to a month prepay, and 2 weeks on purchase. Also there is no foreclosure grace period until 2 weeks.
Multiple characters can now craft at the same anvil, cooking pot, or other crafting node.
Settings changes should no longer be lost when the game crashes.
We Increased XP tables from level 1-10 slightly so players don’t level up so quickly
We removed the series of leveling gift bags and have replaced them with small named gift packs that certain NPCs in Oak Valley give to players. In general players get about the same amount of goods, but they get them at better times rather than all at the end.
All elder parts now have a unique 3D icon to show what they are (instead of the old pyramids)
When Arcron performs an elder restoration, there is now a fancy lightshow.
Charters of all levels now give Charter Tokens 
We made several lighting fixes in Pyrron zones
We tweaked some of the sizes of the monster part 3d loot.
The following negative effects are now curable by the priests cure spell: Confuse, Bewildering Blast, Spore Cloud, Spore Blast, Condemn, Malevolent Roots, Shadow Howl, Frightful Bite, Fear, Paralyzing Fear, Chilling Cry, Doom
Players can now walk beneath Pyrrus legs in Pyrron Courtyard. 


 Bugs Fixed 

Fixed: Some Steam Players can't buy crowns. We need to detect if the user does not have the overlay turned on, and if so, post a pop-up to explain what they need to do to enable the Steam Overlay, as well as redirect to the Steam website to complete the purchase.
We fixed a bug causing strafing and moving backwards to sometimes start off not matching camera direction.
Fixed: You are at -52 -253 68 in Shadow Fated Vega, The water is transparent in this location.
Fixed: Level 70 Decoction - making 1 level 70 decoction requires 3 level 65 decoctions and 1 water.
Fixed: We added some tech to hopefully speed up frame rate in The undercroft.
Fixed a bug that was causing Venom of the Serpent to not look correct when cast.
We fixed a bug that caused warrior mobs who cast Huzzah to not be able to attack
We fixed a bug causing signs to show nothing.
The game will now repair itself if it detects it has been corrupted.
We fixed a bug causing the game to freeze while sending a bug report (ironic, we know!)


 The following bugs were hot-fixed last week 

We fixed a bug preventing guild players from getting a house in their guild village.
Exception typo: server grabbing prefs from db
Fixed a bug with the Quest log that made it not work for some people at the start of the game.
We Reduced the respawn times of monsters in the first two zones.
We balanced the early zones with more channels so they can accommodate a larger influx of players
We fixed a crash bug caused by some assets not being properly unzipped. This was the second most common crash bug. This would cause the game to crash when launching.
We improved patcher/launcher download rates. It should no longer be too slow to download.
We fixed a bug that prevented certain Brazilian players from signing in from Steam.
We fixed a very rare bug that caused DLC items to sometimes not be granted immediately. NOTE: Players who did not get their items initially will automatically receive them now.


 Bugs We Cannot Reproduce (or we need more information) 

“Having problems with showing Cheery the signet from Shangri. It won't work either having ring in bag or on me. The dialogue box does not change either way. Plz could you help.”
“Vega not giving xp for players within 10 lvls only for 5 lvls”

notes.title: Dev Diary: Combat, Movement, Camera Design Iteration
notes.content:
(German translation here / deutsche Übersetzung hier

Hello Everyone,

Many players have requested we make the combat, movement, and camera snappier and cleaner.  This is a short post of our raw design docs of how we're planning to improve these things.

Again, this is raw design-- we don't spend a lot of time making it pretty, just making sure it's clear.  Feel free to offer advice and comment.
Thanks!

Click to Move
Default this to OFF for new players.

WASD Sensitivity
When the player presses one of the WASD keys, it should accelerate the player's rotational or translational speed over a period of time until it reaches max. I don't think we need a slider for this. It should take about 0.5 seconds to reach max (we can tweak this). This will allow players to tap a key to make small adjustments to direction or position. That's the main goal-- to allow players to have finer control.

Right Mouse Button
Right Mouse Button should no longer control the avatar's direction when the player is not moving. Instead, it should work just like LMB--it controls the camera's direction. Of course, this means that when the player starts to move forward, they will move in the direction of the camera because that is already how it works.

When the player is moving, then yes, the RMB will still control the avatar's direction.

A great side effect of this is that RMB rotate will no longer cancel auto-attack.

Auto-Run
When the player has Auto-Run activated (when Num Lock is held), then RMB+mouse should control direction, and LMB+mouse should pan camera.

Forward Strafe (aka, Diagonal Strafe)
Basically, do a simple fix for this so that when the player does a diagonal strafe (ex: press W + E), then the avatar turns to face in the direction he or she is running, but the camera does not move to be directly behind the avatar. In other words, the camera should still behave as if the character is not rotated in the direction he is running.  This is to avoid the rather silly sliding sideways animation currently in the game. :)

Importantly, when the player stops, the avatar would of course snap back to face the direction he or she was going before doing the diagonal strafe.

Another point: the avatar should move at the same speed as when he is moving forward normally. So, neither faster, nor slower.

Also, the angle currently for diagonal strafe is a little too high. Try it with 30 degrees for now. (And also, make it a set angle. Now I think the angle might change based on various run boosts).

Finally, the head should turn to face in the same direction as the camera (not at the camera-- but in the same direction the camera is facing).

Combat Fixes

RMB (above) change will have the advantage of no longer causing accidentally aborted combat.
When the player initiates combat (regardless of how-- auto-attack, etc.), the avatar should instantly snap its rotation to face directly at the enemy.
When the player initiates combat, and the avatar runs to get into range of the target, it should run at full speed, and not decelerate as it nears the target. Therefore, make it stop instantly when reaching attacking distance. Currently it fumbles around with acceleration, rotation, and deceleration creating a non-snappy, sluggish feeling.


Quicker Feedback for Player Action

When the player selects a target, it can take up to a second before the cameo pops up. It would be nice if it popped up immediately. I don't know if any of that info is already sitting on the client (it seems that name, 3d model, and health are already on the client), but if so, we could pop the cameo instantly with this partial information.
The feat/spell icon animation when activating takes too long. It does a shrink and grow and plays a white burst. It should be a quick flash, almost instant, and probably not pulse in size. The goal is to have quick punctuated feedback that the system recognized the user's action.
When the player selects or targets an enemy, and the feat bar pops up--instead of having it slide up, make it instantly pop up. We can still use the slide effect for making it go away and when the player mouses over it to bring it up.


Iteration #2
Auto-Select
When the player does not have any target, then feat & spell icons should be lit (currently, offensive spells/feats will only light up when a target is selected). The player can still try to cast the feat or spell. When they do, the game will try to pick a valid target:

the game tries to pick out a valid target for the spell or feat. Obviously, it should be an enemy for an offensive spell. Then it picks the nearest valid target that is in front of the player within a reasonable range. If there are none, it will consider enemies that are behind the player.
If it finds a valid target, then that target is selected (cameo pops up), the spell or feat is targeted at that enemy, and that enemy will now be auto-attacked.
If it does not find a valid target, the game will play the animation for the feat or spell, but it will stop without firing a missile, etc. and no spirit will be deducted.



Move & Attack
When a player first clicks on an enemy to attack it (either with auto-attack or with an offensive spell), then the player's avatar will engage the enemy (just like now). By this, I mean the player will snap to face the target and move to be within range. That's the same as now.

Here's the change: the player should still be allowed to move around, and this will not cancel auto-attack, or even a spell or feat in progress. HOWEVER, if the player moves so the target is out of range, or so the target is not within the +/- 30 degree cone of the player, then the attack or feat/spell will not fire off. However, auto-attack is not cancelled, so that, if the player's target becomes valid again, the auto-attack would resume.

notes.title: Day Four Feedback: We are Listening
notes.content:
(German translation here / deutsche Übersetzung hier)

Hello Players!

Villagers and Heroes has been live on Steam now for nearly 4 days.  Wow! Steam really brings the players.  We are so excited to be on the biggest game portal in the world.

We have received a lot of great advice from all of you on how we can make the game better.  We know that a community of players is the best way to steer the direction of the the game.  It’s the players that bring the game to life.  We are listening.

There are now a ton of things we want to improve and fix.  We want to go as fast as possible, so we want to get a quick build out asap to demonstrate we are listening.

So, the quick build will include some or all of these things:

A & D keys will strafe (instead of rotate) when the player is moving forwards or backwards with the mouse
We will improve the sideways/strafe animation
We will add a dancing animation! (more to come later)
We’ll make the tutorial do a better job of setting the mood of the game, offer more of a challenge, and have some hidden side areas to explore.
We’re going to improve chat to make it easier to use
We’re going to make the UI a little easier to friend and party up with other players.
Moving will not cancel auto-attack--players need to be able to move around while attacking


There are some major bugs we are working on.  The two biggest are: 1. Some players can’t launch the game from Steam.  When they do, nothing happens!  We really want to get this fixed.  We will be contacting some of these players for more information to help us debug the problem.  2. Frequent crash bugs for some players.  Some players are reporting they crash about once every 30 minutes.  Again, we’ll be delving into this.

We do want to apologize also for some of the players getting stuck.  We had to reboot the servers a few times.  These are typical growing pains when you get a huge influx of new players.  This puts extra strain on the servers, and exposes problems we were unaware of.  We’ve fixed many of the problems we found. The game should become more and more stable over time.

And, to our Brazilian players, we are trying to figure out why some of you cannot run or login to the game. Please remain patient.  When we have a fix, we will make an announcement.

Most of all, thanks for all the advice!  Please keep letting us know how to improve the game.

Best Regards,
Damon

p.s. Many of these things were discussed by Diet in an earlier announcement: http://steamcommunity.com/games/263540/announcements/detail/1801747291772990218
I just wanted to give you an update after 4 days.
